title: Sr. Health and Safety Specialist
description:
Role Title:

Sr. Health & Safety Specialist

Reports to:

Health & Safety Manager

Job Type:

Full-time, Regular

Location:

Helvetia, AZ

About Hudbay:

Hudbay (TSX, NYSE: HBM) is a copper-focused mining company with three long-life operations and a world-class pipeline of copper growth projects in tier-one mining-friendly jurisdictions of Canada, Peru and the United States.

Hudbay’s operating portfolio includes the Constancia mine in Cusco (Peru), the Snow Lake operations in Manitoba (Canada) and the Copper Mountain mine in British Columbia (Canada). Copper is the primary metal produced by the company, which is complemented by meaningful gold production. Hudbay’s growth pipeline includes the Copper World project in Arizona, the Mason project in Nevada (United States), the Llaguen project in La Libertad (Peru) and several expansion and exploration opportunities near its existing operations.

The value Hudbay creates and the impact it has is embodied in its purpose statement: “We care about our people, our communities and our planet. Hudbay provides the metals the world needs. We work sustainably, transform lives and create better futures for communities.” Hudbay’s mission is to create sustainable value and strong returns by leveraging its core strengths in community relations, focused exploration, mine development and efficient operations.

Mission:

To create sustainable value and strong returns by leveraging our core strengths in community relations, focused exploration, mine development and efficient operations.

Purpose of Role:

The purpose of the Senior Health & Safety Specialist is to serve as the operational safety lead for the Copper World site, driving a proactive hazard-prevention culture and ensuring total compliance with MSHA and corporate safety standards. Reporting to the Health & Safety Manager and managing site-level Health & Safety Technicians, this role bridges executive safety strategy with day-to-day mine operations. By leading complex incident investigations, executing robust risk-mitigation programs, and overseeing regulatory field readiness, the Senior Specialist protects the health and well-being of all site personnel while safeguarding the project from operational disruptions and regulatory risk.

Role Accountabilities:

  • Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervise and mentor Health & Safety Specialists.
  • Site Management & Inspection: Oversee daily field operations, conduct routine site audits, and identify occupational hazards across mining, processing, and construction areas.
  • Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis: Lead investigations for site incidents, near-misses, and injuries using formal root-cause analysis protocols (e.g., 5-Why, TapRooT). Implement preventative action items.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Maintain full compliance with MSHA and OSHA regulations. Serve as the primary site liaison during regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Program Development: Design and roll out critical risk management initiatives, emergency response plans, and job safety analyses (JSAs).
  • Training & Onboarding: Oversee required site safety training, including MSHA Part 48 certifications, contractor orientations, and specialized task training

Minimum Qualifications and Education:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety or a related technical field
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional health and safety experience specifically within a high-hazard industrial environment (Mining, Oil & Gas, or Heavy Construction).
  • Software Proficiency: Advanced Google Workspace Administrator skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: * Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Certified Mine Safety Professional (CMSP)
  • MSHA Approved Instructor


NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization

Other Requirements:

Physical – The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities may be required for this position.

Work Environment – The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The work environment will necessitate work near moving mechanical parts and outside weather conditions such as hot and/or dry conditions. Work will be conducted in locations where noise, fumes, dust, toxic or caustic chemicals, and vibration may exist.

Employee must be able to prove that he/she has a current and valid driver's license.

Why Hudbay?

  • At Hudbay, our values of Dignity & Respect, Caring, Openness, and Trustworthiness are embedded into our culture by the way we work and how we interact with one another.
  • We pride ourselves in providing our employees with competitive total rewards that include:
    • Annual performance bonuses
    • Affordable medical, dental and vision benefits for you and your family
    • Company paid Life insurance, AD&D, Short- & Long-term Disability
    • 401(k) plan with employer contribution/match
    • An Employee Share Purchase Plan with contribution matching
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Paid time off, paid sick time and holiday pay.
  • Regular performance appraisals to acknowledge our employees for their contributions, strengths and work well done.


Hudbay is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates may be required to undergo educational and criminal background checks. Following a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to successfully complete a post-offer background check and, as applicable to the specific requirements of the role, a physical and/or drug screening.

title: Electrical Instructor
description:
Part time and Full time available

Electrical Instructor – Put Your Experience to Work (No Teaching Experience Needed)

Are you an experienced electrician who’s tired of the grind — emergency calls, long jobsite hours, tight crawl spaces, ladders all day, and the wear-and-tear on your body?

This is your chance to stay in the trade, share what you know, and build a stable, rewarding career training the next generation of electrical professionals.

If you’re ready to step off the jobsite without stepping away from the trade, this could be the next great chapter of your career.

title: Parts & Accessories Professional
description:
Rogers Motors in Hermiston Oregon has full-time openings for Parts and Accessories Professional positions across our Hermiston dealerships. Our employees are motivated, knowledgeable and caring professionals who build long-term client relationships. A hands-on style and a passion for doing what is right by our customers and our community is vital.

Rogers Motors has been a family-owned business supporting our local community for over 55 years. We provide training, mentoring, coaching, and full support to help you succeed. All full-time positions include medical and dental coverage, paid vacation, 401(k) & more. Rogers Motors is a drug-free, equal opportunity employer. Applicants must pass a background check and drug test while possessing a valid driver’s license with an acceptable safe driving record. If you want to join a winning team and continue to drive home the culture of success that we’ve built over the last 55 years, we want to speak with you!

OVERVIEW

The Parts and Accessories Professional sells, at retail, parts to all available customers over the counter, through the shop, or on the phone. A successful candidate for the Parts and Accessories Professional position will have automotive parts and customer service experience.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be friendly, professional and efficient when working with all customers, both on the phone and in person.
  • Provide the same high level of service to the other dealership departments as is given to other customers.
  • Issue credit for parts returned, ensuring that the original invoice, or its number, is available so that purchase and pricing can be verified.
  • Ensure that all charge sales are signed by the customers.
  • Keep front and rear counter areas clean and uncluttered.
  • Replenish assigned inventory daily.
  • Advise Parts Manager when areas of the department are not in satisfactory condition.
  • Keep current on new products and product updates.
  • Provide additional front and rear counter specific assistance relating to answering phone calls, provide price quotes, pulling stock parts, preparing parts for delivery, etc.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • High school diploma or the equivalent.
  • One year of experience in an automotive parts department.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to read and comprehend instructions and information.
  • Ability to work well with the public, sometimes with several customers at a time.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This is a physically demanding position. The Parts and Accessories Professional will move throughout the parts shelves all day, reaching and climbing to obtain parts from inventory. title: Director of Education
description:
Director of Education – Leading Student Success and Academic Excellence

Are you a strategic leader who is passionate about education, workforce development, and student outcomes? Do you thrive in roles where you can guide faculty, strengthen programs, and shape the future of career-focused education?

This is your opportunity to lead the academic vision of a mission-driven trade school while helping students gain the skills needed to build meaningful careers.

We’re looking for an experienced educational leader who values quality instruction, compliance, and continuous improvement. If you’re someone who enjoys building strong teams, improving curriculum, and ensuring students receive exceptional training — we’ll support your success.

What You’ll Be Doing

As Director of Education, you will assist with the oversight of the academic operations of the institution, ensuring programs deliver high-quality, industry-relevant education while maintaining compliance with accreditor and regulatory requirements. You will serve as a key campus resource for instructional quality, retention initiatives, student support, accreditation readiness, and faculty training and development.

Must be flexible with shift hours due to position responsibilities, including flexing to evening hours minimum two evenings per week. Additional hours as needed.

  • Provide strategic leadership and day-to-day oversight of academic programs, instructional staff, curriculum, and education operations in partnership with the Campus Director and Program Coordinators.
  • Lead faculty recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, training, evaluation, observations, and professional development while fostering a collaborative, student-centered learning environment.
  • Ensure curriculum, instruction, and instructional methodologies align with institutional goals, industry standards, workforce needs, accreditation requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Oversee curriculum development, program updates, courseware, Program Management Plans, and continuous improvement initiatives to support instructional quality and student outcomes.
  • Monitor student academic progress, attendance, SAP status, retention, completion, graduation, and satisfaction outcomes; coordinate at-risk student interventions, Academic Plans, academic recovery, re-enrollment, and student success initiatives.
  • Serve as the campus coordinator for retention and student success, facilitating retention meetings, maintaining action plans, monitoring intervention effectiveness, and communicating trends and recommendations to campus leadership.
  • Partner with Admissions, Student Services, Career Services, Program Coordinators, and other campus departments to support student onboarding, engagement, persistence, completion, re-entry, and overall student success.
  • Oversee academic policies and processes related to grading, attendance, SAP, academic standing, student conduct, and other academic requirements while ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up.
  • Oversee academic scheduling, calendars, classroom and laboratory utilization, instructor coverage, instructional staffing plans, and related budget considerations.
  • Support accreditation, regulatory, and institutional compliance efforts, including preparation for audits and accreditation visits and maintenance of required academic, faculty, and student success documentation.
  • Monitor academic and student success data, generate required reports through SAP and Learning Management Systems, and use data to identify trends, inform resource allocation, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support New Student Orientation, graduation ceremonies, student recognition events, Program Advisory Committee meetings, and other campus engagement activities.
  • Represent the campus within the external academic and professional community and collaborate across departments to advance institutional and student success goals.

Minimum Requirements

Required:

  • Associate degree, post-secondary diploma/certificate equivalent, or higher required
  • Minimum 3 years of direct or indirect supervisory and/or leadership experience required
  • Minimum 3 years of teaching experience required
  • Strong knowledge of academic policies, student progress monitoring, and instructional best practices
  • Experience supporting accreditation, compliance, or regulatory standards
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication, coaching, and conflict-resolution abilities
  • Proficiency with learning management systems (LMS), student information systems (SIS), and standard office software

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience in career-focused, technical, or trade school education
  • Experience with curriculum design and program development
  • Experience supporting accreditation reviews or institutional audits


Why Work With Us?

As Director of Education, you will shape the learning experience that prepares students for real-world careers. You’ll lead talented instructors, strengthen programs, and ensure that education remains practical, relevant, and aligned with industry demand.

Supported by Admissions, Student Services, Career Services, and Compliance teams, you’ll play a key leadership role in ensuring students not only enroll — but succeed, graduate, and enter the workforce with confidence.

If you’re passionate about education, leadership, and helping students build better futures — this is the role for you.

About Our Company:

Porter and Chester Institute, a trade school in Connecticut and Massachusetts for 75 years, adheres to one basic vision: to educate and train our students to the level that will make them competent employees. With 9 campus locations throughout Connecticut and Massachusetts, we offer training in such trades as Automotive Technology, HVAC-R, CAD, Electrician, Plumbing, as well as Medical Assisting, Dental Assisting, Practical Nursing and Computer & Technology.

Our support staff, including Admissions, Financial Aid and other administrative professionals, to our qualified Instructors are focused on making the students' experience a fulfilling and enriching one, both professionally and personally.

title: China Market Intelligence & Commercial Lead (he/she/they)
description:
Since 2000, EUPD Group has established itself as a trusted, independent voice in the renewable energy industry. Our work centers on primary data-driven market research, quality certification, and strategic consulting in the areas of photovoltaics, energy storage, and the energy transition. Internationally positioned, we support organizations - from ambitious start-ups to global corporations - in navigating change with clarity, backed by more than 25 years of market experience.

As China's dual-carbon agenda reshapes the domestic industry and Chinese renewable energy companies go global at speed, we are establishing our own presence here - not a nameplate office, but a local team with a real mandate, built together with the colleague who joins us now.

About the Role

We are looking for a China Market Intelligence & Commercial Lead to drive business development in China, build senior industry relationships, and provide the European headquarters with a clear understanding of the Chinese market.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone who combines industry knowledge, commercial capability, strong relationships and market intelligence.

Tasks

  • Drive the commercial development and sales of our market intelligence, research and consulting solutions in China.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with leading companies and senior decision-makers across the PV and energy storage value chain, including modules, batteries, inverters, PCS and ESS.
  • Monitor Chinese market developments, customer needs, competitive dynamics and emerging trends to identify new business opportunities.
  • Translate customer and market insights into recommendations for new research products, consulting solutions and commercial opportunities.
  • Represent the company at major solar PV, energy storage and renewable energy conferences and industry events in China and internationally.
  • Work closely with the European headquarters and global team, connecting Chinese market insights with international market developments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in solar PV, energy storage, renewable energy, market intelligence, consulting, strategy or a related industry.
  • Strong understanding of the Chinese PV and energy storage value chain and key market players.
  • Established relationships and network within the Chinese renewable energy industry; access to senior decision-makers is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in B2B business development, consulting, research or data-driven solution sales.
  • Strong commercial mindset, analytical ability and communication skills.
  • Active,
    hands-on use of AI and automation tools in daily work, paired with a genuine
    interest in continuously improving and streamlining processes.
  • Fluent Mandarin and excellent professional English.
  • Comfortable working in an international, English-speaking environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently within China and internationally.
  • Experience in industry conferences, panels, speaking engagements or media is a strong plus.

Benefits

  • Exciting, data-driven projects in the renewable energy, storage, and solar sector - with direct relevance to fast-moving markets and to the overseas strategies of leading Chinese manufacturers.
  • Access to our primary research on European and global installers, channels, and end customers - insight most of the market never sees.
  • A direct line to our German headquarters: flat structures, no reporting layers, and real influence on how we build up China.
  • High degree of autonomy and freedom in organizing your own work and schedule - we assess outcomes, not attendance.
  • Fair, project- and outcome-based fee structure, with clear terms agreed in advance.
  • Potential for further projects/engagements based on successful collaboration, and a hand in growing the China business itself.
  • Professional exchange on current developments in solar, storage, and renewables with analysts who track these markets year-round.

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who can: Understand the industry / Understand the customer / Leverage the network / Identify opportunities / Develop business / Shape products.
The successful candidate will serve as an important bridge between China, our European headquarters and the global renewable energy industry.

Iowa Farm Bureau....where the grass really IS greener!

description:

Position Title: Postgraduate Education Fellow

Supervisor: Director of Farm Based Youth Programs & Early Ed Program

Employment period: January - November

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8am-4pm (hours may vary, see below)

Pay: $1,360 paid biweekly (equivalent of $35,360/year) + shared, on-site housing (optional)

Location: In-person at Shelburne Farms

Application Deadline: 9/28/26


Who We Are

Shelburne Farms is an education nonprofit on a mission to inspire and cultivate learning for a sustainable future. We believe that transformative learning experiences sow the seeds for a thriving and more just world. Our work seeks to create the space, spark the conversations, and share the stories to inspire educators, students, and learners of all ages to build a better future for everyone.

We realize our mission by integrating three key areas of activity: our programs, place, and products.


Commitment to Justice, Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

Shelburne Farms recognizes that justice, equity, and access are central to sustainability. We are committed to translating these values into action across the organization by improving equitable outcomes in our culture, programs, and services. Shelburne Farms is working to create experiences of belonging for all, including BIPOC, LGBTQ+ communities, people with disabilities, and people of all economic realities.


Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking postgraduate-level individuals interested in learning from and working alongside our farm-based education programs and staff. The fellows have the opportunity to live onsite and are immersed in the daily rhythms of the farm and the cycle of the seasons.

A majority of the fellow’s time will be spent with our school programs, summer day camp and Children’s Farmyard with additional time spent among our early childhood programs; family and public programs. Our school programs work primarily with elementary age youth in onsite field trips and community outreach. Our summer camps focus on hosting youth for outdoor, farm-based, day-camp experiences. The Children’s Farmyard is open to the public and provides school, camp, and youth group visits from May through October where visitors explore their connection to farm animals to understand where our food and fiber originates. Early childhood programs are full and half-day programs for preschool and early elementary-aged children. Our family and public programs happen mainly in the evenings and on the weekends with a variety of programs and special events offered throughout the summer.

Mentorship will be provided by education staff members; shared resources; and through independent reflection. Shelburne Farms is committed to fostering a culturally aware learning community that is open to multiple perspectives.

Fellowships for the 2027 year will be from mid-January to November 19, 2027.


Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in an orientation to Shelburne Farms and to the fellow role.

  • Participate in farmyard and summer camp training sessions (possibly including tractor driving training).

  • Meet with the supervisor to create professional goals and a personalized learning plan.

  • Check in regularly with mentors and periodically with supervisor to discuss performance, professional goals, and learning plan.

  • Observe, team teach, and teach activities for Shelburne Farms school programs, camp, children’s farmyard, and family and public programs (seasonally specific).

  • Participate in daily program set-up and debrief meetings with the education team.

  • Support and/or teach family programs and public events on occasional weekends.

  • Participate in and/or provide support for seasonal special events.

  • Attend planning meetings for programs and spend time preparing lessons and materials.

  • Work on education support projects on non-teaching days.

  • Participate in professional learning opportunities (when available) and staff meetings.

  • Communicate effectively with coworkers to create a respectful and communicative work environment.

  • Receive and incorporate constructive feedback from supervisor and mentors into teaching practice.

  • Practice reflection on teaching skills, learning, and daily work and incorporate new learning for continued professional growth.

  • Support a continuous effort to foster a culturally responsive learning community, respectful and inclusive of multiple perspectives.


Preferred Qualifications

  • College graduate

  • Interest and/or prior experience with education, sustainability, or farm-based education.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about education practices and programs; communicating with a variety of audiences; farming practices; food systems; animal care; and more.

  • Prior work experience with camps or education programs.

  • Positive and flexible attitude with co-workers and visitors.

  • Solution-oriented mindset when faced with challenges.

  • Demonstrate initiative and display motivation in work and to seek out learning opportunities.

  • Ability to follow directions in assigned tasks and work independently.

  • Communicative with an interest in engaging with people of different ages and backgrounds.

  • Openness to receive supportive praise and constructive feedback and make adjustments with a growth mindset.


Requirements

  • Available to work Monday-Friday 8am-4pm (hours may vary to include early morning chores and/or camp early care or after care services; schedule will be planned with your input in advance).

  • Occasional weekend work to support family and public programs and seasonal special events.

  • Commitment to work from January to November.

  • A completed background check is a condition of employment as you’re working with minors.


Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Outdoor work environment with varied weather conditions.

  • Movement over uneven terrain.

  • Move up to 40 lbs.

  • Work with and around large farm animals.

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


Benefits

Deadline to Apply

To Apply

Within your application, please include a resume, letter of interest and contacts for two references.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Community Programs Assistant (II)
location: Tree House Humane Society, Chicago, IL, US
description:
JOB TITLE: Community Programs Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Operations

REPORTS TO: Senior Manager, Community Programs

SUPERVISES: N/A

CLASSIFICATION: Non-exempt, Hourly

EFFECTIVE DATE: 8/2026


Applications received by September 22 will be prioritized in our review. Applications received after that may be reviewed based on volume and need.

SUMMARY: The Community Programs Assistant supports the operational and field-based efforts of the Community Programs Team, including Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR), Cats at Work (CAW), pet transport services, vaccine events, and community cat support initiatives. Using a non-judgmental, community-centered approach, these programs work to empower and support our target communities in accessing resources and services that support the humane care and management of cats and pets within our targeted Chicago communities.

This position is highly hands-on and field-oriented, requiring travel throughout Chicago to support TNR projects, community cat relocation efforts, pet transport services, and direct client assistance.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Field Operations & Program Support:

  • Responds to CAW and TNR general inquiries via phone call and email.
  • Conducts site visits and inspections to help identify potential territories for at-risk feral cats.
  • Supports community cat relocation and transfer efforts, working with partner organizations and caregivers.
  • Works with the Community Cats Coordinator to support TNR operations: trapping cats at project sites, transporting them for medical services, and returning them to their outdoor homes.
  • Builds respectful and positive relationships with community members while supporting humane community cat management practices.
  • Provides support, assistance, and resources to community members caring for or having issues with free-roaming cats. This includes the proper care, housing, handling, and enrichment of community cats.
  • Collaboratively prepares, cleans, and disinfects traps, transport equipment, and field supplies needed for daily operations.
  • Helps maintain an organized and orderly appearance of assigned areas and vehicles at all times.
  • Completes required documentation, client communication, and administrative tasks related to program operations.
  • Assists with volunteer engagement and support during field and operational activities.

Community & Event Support:

  • Participates in transporting pets to and from our clinic for spay/neuter.
  • Joins and facilitates food drop-offs for our pantry clients and maintains organization of the pantry storage area, including the donation area.
  • Assists with vaccine clinics and high-volume community events.
  • Supports community resource distribution efforts, including pet food deliveries and supply coordination.
  • Helps prepare and organize materials and supplies for outreach events and community programs.
  • Provides support for community-based events, including tabling efforts, educational workshops, and canvassing to expand awareness and access to pet health services, community cat care, and Tree House programs.
  • Engages with and trains volunteers in various aspects of the program.


Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

● This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Spanish-speaking required.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license to drive Tree House vehicles.
  • High School degree or equivalent required.
  • Coursework or experience in animal welfare, community outreach, social services, veterinary support, or related fields preferred.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in customer service, community-based work, animal care, field operations, nonprofit work, or related environments.
  • Computer skills required: Microsoft Office
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build positive relationships with community members, caregivers, volunteers, and partner organizations.
  • Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions and handling physically demanding tasks, including lifting traps, carriers, pet food, and other supplies.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records, supplies, and documentation.
  • Comfortable learning and following humane community cat management and handling practices, including TNR protocols.
  • Ability to adapt to changing daily tasks and field conditions.
  • Ability to work weekends and evening shifts


COMPETENCIES:

● Attendance & Dependability - Is consistently at work and on time. Follows instructions and responds to management direction. Provides consistent, timely, high-quality work. Follow through on commitments. Uses time efficiently. Takes responsibility for own actions.

● Customer Service - Treats customers (internal and external) with respect and courtesy. Shows interest in, anticipates, and responds timely to customer needs and concerns. Goes beyond basic service expectations to help customers. Responds appropriately to and resolves difficult and emotional situations. Seeks ways to improve service delivery.

● Diversity - Enthusiastically works with all employees, regardless of race, gender, culture, and age. Values contributions of people from diverse backgrounds. Demonstrates respect for opinions and ideas of others. Shows awareness of and sensitivity to cultural and individual values.

● Ethics - Respects and maintains confidentiality. Tells the truth and is honest in all dealings. Avoids situations and actions considered inappropriate or which present a conflict of interest. Upholds organizational values. Does not misrepresent self or use position or authority for personal gain.

● Teamwork - Listens and responds constructively to others' views. Gives and welcomes feedback. Provides assistance to others when they need it. Shares expertise. Acknowledges others' effort and contribution. Puts the success of the team above their own interests. Creates a positive work environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This position is primarily field-based and requires frequent outdoor work.
  • Must be able to safely lift, carry, push, and/or move up to 40 pounds.
  • Regular physical activity is required, including bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, climbing, balancing, and handling animals.
  • Frequently required to stand and walk for extended periods; occasionally required to sit.
  • Work is performed in a variety of settings, including outdoor locations, shelter, and clinic environments.
  • Continual exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Regular exposure to animals, animal waste, cleaning chemicals, and noise typical of animal care environments.
  • Regular interaction with staff, volunteers, community members, and members of the public in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
  • May involve interaction with individuals in high-stress or emotionally sensitive situations.


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Monday to Friday. Position will occasionally have to work weekends based on operational needs.

title: Quality Control
description:
Overview:

The Quality Technician is responsible for supporting quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities on utility-scale solar PV and BESS construction projects. This position performs field inspections, verifies installations against approved drawings and specifications, documents quality findings, and works closely with project teams to identify and correct deficiencies.

The Quality Technician will work directly with Quality, Field Operations, Engineering, Safety, and Project Management to help ensure construction activities meet project requirements, manufacturer specifications, applicable codes and standards, and company quality expectations.

This is a hands-on field position requiring strong attention to detail, the ability to read construction drawings and specifications, and a working knowledge of solar tracker and racking systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Company’s QA/QC program for solar construction projects, including PV, BESS, and associated civil, electrical, and structural scopes
  • Follow established quality procedures, inspection checklists, and documentation requirements
  • Ensure quality processes are aligned with contractual obligations, engineering standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct regular site audits and inspections to verify work complies with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards
  • Identify and document non-conforming work, issue NCRs, and track corrective and preventive actions through resolution
  • Support field teams with constructability reviews, quality planning, and best-practice guidance
  • Verify proper installation of major components including modules, racking, trackers, foundations, cabling, inverters, and BESS systems
  • Maintain accurate quality records, inspection reports, test results, and turnover documentation
  • Ensure proper document control by verifying that current drawings, specifications, and revisions are being utilized in the field.
  • Utilize Procure to document inspections, observations, deficiencies, corrective actions, photographs, and other project quality records
  • Support project closeout and handover by verifying quality documentation completeness and accuracy
  • Assist with identifying quality trends, root causes of defects, and rework drivers to implement continuous improvement initiatives
  • Coordinate with Engineering and field leadership to resolve design issues, RFIs, and field deviations
  • Partner with Safety to ensure quality and safety standards are aligned and reinforced
  • Work with Project Management to track quality metrics, schedule impacts, and cost implications
  • Perform additional quality-related duties and inspections as assigned

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Technical training, trade experience, or an associate or bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Electrical Technology, Quality, or a related field is preferred but not required
  • 2+ years of construction, solar, electrical, mechanical, or QA/QC experience preferred.
  • Utility-scale solar PV or BESS construction experience strongly preferred
  • Experience working with or inspecting solar tracker/racking systems such as ATI, FlexRack, and Nextracker is strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, and inspection processes
  • Experience identifying, documenting, and resolving non-conforming work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development.
  • A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to make a significant impact in the rapidly growing energy sector.

We are an equal opportunity employer

title: Technical Writer
description:
Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.

This is a unique opportunity to join Quantum Motion's newly established Marketing team as one of its founding team members. Reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you'll have the autonomy to shape our technical storytelling, influence our content strategy, and make a meaningful impact from day one. Working cross-functionally with Product, R&D, Business Development, and leadership, you'll bring our breakthrough technology to life through compelling, high-impact content that inspires customers, partners, investors, and the wider quantum community.

In this role, you will:

  • Transform innovation into compelling stories by collaborating with the Product team to create engaging technical articles, benchmark reports, application notes, and white papers that showcase the performance and capabilities of Quantum Motion's technology.

  • Bring our science to life by partnering with world-class researchers and engineers to communicate technological breakthroughs, research milestones, and our long-term vision through clear, accessible, and inspiring narratives.

  • Enable commercial success by working with the Marketing and Business Development team to create persuasive customer success stories, testimonials, use cases, and application-focused content that demonstrates the real-world impact of our technology and supports strategic customer engagement.

  • Shape our voice across every channel by contributing technical expertise to press releases, website content, social media, executive communications, presentations, thought leadership articles, and integrated marketing campaigns, ensuring every piece of content is scientifically accurate, engaging, and aligned with our brand.

  • Build Quantum Motion's reputation as a global leader by translating complex quantum computing concepts into compelling content that educates, inspires, and positions the company at the forefront of one of the world's most exciting emerging technologies.


  • Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or another closely related technical discipline.

  • Proven experience within an industry setting, preferred within a scale-up company

  • Proven experience in technical writing with exceptional copywriting and editorial skills, producing clear, engaging, and accurate technical content.

  • Native-level or highly proficient written and spoken English, with excellent attention to detail and editorial quality.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technical concepts and translate them into compelling content for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience managing content projects independently, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders including Product, R&D, Marketing, Business Development, and leadership.

  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  • A proactive, self-starting mindset, comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to create content that supports product launches, customer engagement, and broader business objectives.

  • Experience writing about quantum computing, quantum technologies, advanced physics, semiconductors, hardware manufacturing, or other deep-tech industries.

  • Experience developing technical marketing content such as white papers, benchmark reports, customer case studies, application notes, thought leadership articles, and technical blogs.

  • Passion for science and technology, with a natural curiosity and enthusiasm for making complex innovations accessible and engaging to diverse audiences.

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

title: Commercial Video Editor
description:

Why join Goalhanger?

title: Radiology Technician
description:
• Starting pay for this position is based upon years of experience
  • On call time is expected with this position along with weekends and holidays
  • Performance bonus offered with this position.

General Purpose: The purpose of the Radiologic Technologist position at Niobrara Community Hospital (NCH) is to perform X-ray and Computed Tomography (CT) diagnostic procedures on patients to meet the established practice parameters and standards of care. Works as a member of the health care team including physicians, nurses and other health care professionals in diagnostic testing procedures such as x-ray, computed tomography, trauma and outpatient procedures. Performs clerical duties, transports patients as required, processes images and maintains proper inventory of supplies. Assists with quality control/performance improvement measures as required. Must be available to work a rotating On Call and Call Back Schedule.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities: Performs a variety of technical and supportive activities in a hospital to assist medical staff in the diagnosis and treatment of patients to include operating x-ray equipment and CT equipment to standards association with the ARRT clinical practice guidelines. Prepare patients for diagnostic procedures to include obtaining radiographs/CT’s. Assume triage responsibility for maintaining the orderly and efficient flow of patients through the radiology department. Calibrate and perform routine maintenance on x-ray and CT equipment to ensure proper functioning; clean and sterilize instruments, supplies and equipment. Follows written and verbal instructions. Work under limited supervision; demonstrate ability to work without immediate supervision. Maintain effective filing system. Maintain positive relationships with hospital staff, medical staff, patients and visitors. Participate in problem solving as needed. Operates fixed and mobile radiographic equipment to produce routine diagnostic medical images. Computes techniques and adjusts control panel settings such as kilovoltage, exposure time, milliamperage, and focal spot size. Positions patients to image desired anatomic structures. Selects image recording media, adjust table or cassette holder, aligns x-ray tube for correct distance and angle, and restricts radiation beam for maximum patient protection. Exposes and processes images. Operates equipment associated with Digital Radiography, diagnostic/clinical workstations, optical disk storage systems, network and computer interface. Preforms general diagnostic imaging activities; reproduces images. Cleans and inspects equipment and performs preventive maintenance. Receives patients, prepares and processes examination requests and related records, files reports. Knowledge of supplies, equipment and/or services ordering and inventory control.

Other Duties/Responsibilities: Maintain quality, safety and/or infection control standards. Perform other related duties as required to ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Radiology Technologist will be expected to work a rotating On Call and Call Back Schedule.

Knowledge, Skills, and Ability: Must have the ability to read, write, and understand English. Must be licensed as a Radiology Technologist in the State of Wyoming. Possess one year’s experience as a Radiologic Technologist and a Computed Tomography Technologist. Must be currently certified in Basic Life Support Certification (BLS) required.

Minimum education: Associate degree of Radiology Technology, Certification of Computed Tomography and ARRT Registered and Licensed by the State of Wyoming.

Experience: One year of X-ray and one year of CT experience in similar clinical setting.

Working Environment: Working in a hospital creates a unique work environment of both confidentiality and hospitality. The addition of an Extended Care Facility to the organization creates of a level of expectation for the behavior of all employees when interacting with the residents on a daily basis. This is the residents’ home and as such requires an additional level of attention to detail from all staff. An interaction with staff, patients and patients families also occurs on a daily basis and must be conducted in a professional manner. Normal noise levels (those of business office with large equipment) can be expected.

title: Photonics Engineer (Quantum Sensing) (f/m/d)
description:
QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As a full-time Photonics Engineer (Quantum Sensing), you will join our multidisciplinary Hardware Pre-Development Team, taking hands-on technical ownership of maturing the illumination and imaging systems of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM) from early concepts to lab-validated prototypes, ready for handover into product development.

We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in photonics and optical technologies, who enjoys challenging technical limitations, thinks in systems, and can troubleshoot performance end to end. Your focus is on the earliest, most exploratory phase of our optical systems: proving out innovative concepts and assessing their feasibility, from early ideas to lab-validated prototypes. Throughout this process, you will work closely with the optical designers in our Product Development Team, culminating in a smooth handover of mature, validated technologies into serial-ready design.

Typical projects range from optimizing illumination schemes to increase photon collection efficiency and thereby magnetic field sensitivity, to advancing our imaging optics toward higher spatial resolution.
In this role, you will have the rare opportunity to significantly shape the illumination and imaging advancements on our technological roadmap and directly contribute to QuantumDiamonds' ambitious goals.

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Picture this:
  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!
  • Tackle fundamental, unsolved technical limitations across the full quantum-sensing system, from illumination and the diamond sensor to imaging, by developing new ideas and proving them out experimentally in the lab, systematically removing optical bottlenecks to improve key system parameters such as sensitivity and spatial resolution.
  • Evaluate and de-risk optical concepts through simulation (e.g., ray tracing, beam propagation) before committing to hardware, deriving target requirements and predicting feasibility and limitations at an early stage.
  • Stay on top of novel optical components, coatings, micro-optics, and modern fabrication possibilities, drawing on this knowledge to develop new ideas and approaches, and turning designs into physical prototypes.
  • Drive fast, iterative development cycles that de-risk new technologies and generate quick feedback through a fail-fast, fail-cheap culture.
  • Ensure a smooth handover of mature, validated technologies to the optical designers in our Product Development Team, documenting your methodology and findings along the way and building on close collaboration throughout.
  • A degree in Photonics, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, along with a few years of relevant hands-on industry or research experience.
  • Strong, hands-on lab experience building, aligning, and characterizing optical setups, combined with the systems-level thinking to understand how illumination, optics, and the underlying physical sensor principle work together, troubleshoot real-world setups, trace issues to their root cause, and characterize their impact on overall sensitivity and spatial resolution.
  • Experience in optical system design and simulation (e.g., using Zemax OpticStudio) to support your hands-on work.
  • A curious, exploratory mindset: you enjoy testing new ideas hands-on and aren't afraid to challenge conventional approaches or think unconventionally when navigating the solution space.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative environment as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Nice to have: broad, up-to-date knowledge of optical manufacturing technologies and emerging trends in the field.
  • Nice to have: experience with widefield NV magnetometry or comparable microscopy technologies (e.g., fluorescence or confocal microscopy).
  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

title: Data Engineer – Business Intelligence & Dashboards
description:
We're Hiring: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence & Dashboards!

We are seeking a skilled and analytical Data Engineer to join our team in Singapore. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines for business intelligence solutions and dashboards. If you thrive in transforming data into actionable insights and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams, this role is for you.

Location: Singapore, Singapore

Work Mode: Work from Office

Role: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence & Dashboards

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with business units across the organization to understand their data and reporting needs
  • Facilitate requirements workshops and interviews to document data requirements, KPIs, and reporting use cases
  • Translate business requirements into clear data specifications for the data engineering team
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the technical data platform team

Data Transformation & Modelling

  • Design and develop data transformation logic to prepare curated datasets for reporting and analytics consumption
  • Build and maintain data models in Amazon Redshift or the curated/consumption zone of the Data Lake
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness for all reporting datasets
  • Apply data quality checks and validation rules to support trustworthy business insights

Dashboard & Visualisation Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau (connected via Amazon Redshift or S3)
  • Create near-real-time operational dashboards, ad-hoc analysis views, and scheduled reports tailored to business unit needs
  • Ensure dashboards are intuitive and accessible for non-technical end users
  • Iterate on dashboard designs based on user feedback and evolving business requirements

Data Catalogue & Documentation

  • Document data definitions, business glossary terms, and dashboard logic in the AWS Glue Data Catalogue
  • Maintain clear documentation of data sources, transformation logic, and report specifications
  • Support self-service analytics by enabling business users to discover and access data independently

Requirements

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a data engineering, business intelligence, or data analyst role
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and modelling
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tools (Power BI, QuickSight) for dashboard development
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms (AWS preferred - Amazon Redshift, S3, AWS Glue)
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements
  • Experience in data modelling for analytics (star schema, dimensional modelling)

Preferred

  • Familiarity with Python for data transformation and automation
  • Experience with AWS Glue Data Catalogue or similar metadata management tools
  • Exposure to Salesforce or other SaaS data sources
  • Prior experience working in a government, or public sector environment
  • Understanding of data governance and data quality principles

title: MOTOR VEHICLE TECH II
description:
Performs routine (journey-level) motor vehicle maintenance and repair work. Work involves repairing or replacing worn or broken parts; performing preventive maintenance activities; and servicing motor vehicle equipment and related gasoline, diesel, or alternative fuel engine-powered equipment. Works under moderate supervision, with limited latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. Exchanges, rebuilds, and overhauls motors, transmissions, carburetors, and other motor vehicle components and systems. Must be flexible to work evening and weekend hours as required. Performs vehicle cleaning both interior and exterior. Documents repairs and routine maintenance of vehicles and equipment. Performs work in emergency situations as required. Performs oil and filter changes, transmission service, brake and suspension repair, tire installation and repair, wheel alignments, air conditioning diagnosis and repair, state vehicle inspections, and other scheduled maintenance. Performs minor engine tune-ups and makes required adjustments on motor vehicles’ motors and engines. Performs motor vehicle body repair work and touch-up painting. Performs safety and emissions inspections. Tests motors and engines for satisfactory performance. Installs after-market accessories and equipment. Maintains records of work performed and parts used. May maintain and repair heavy construction equipment. Performs other such related duties as may be assigned. Experience in motor vehicle maintenance and repair work. Graduation from a standard senior high school or equivalent, supplemented by technical courses in motor vehicle maintenance and repair, is generally preferred. Knowledge of motor vehicle maintenance, of repair techniques, and of safety practices and principles.Skill in the use of tools and equipment. Ability to follow instructions, to make repairs, and to use tools and equipment. The ability to communicate in English and Spanish is preferred. Registration, Certification, or Licensure. Requires a certification from the National Institute of Automotive Service Excellence or ability to obtain within the first year of employment. Texas Motor Vehicle Safety Inspector license and Texas Certified Tow Operator preferred. Requires a valid Texas Commercial driver’s license or ability to obtain within the first year of employment. This position is classified as a safety sensitive position in accordance with FTA’s rules and regulations.

title: Mobile & Full Stack Application Development Analyst
description:
Job Summary

We are an established property and retail organisation managing a portfolio of shopping destinations. Our loyalty programme connects members with participating malls and tenants through a mobile application that supports rewards points and other digital services.

The Loyalty team works closely with marketing teams and technology vendors to enhance the member experience and deliver new digital capabilities. We are looking for a Mobile & Full Stack Application Developer who can take ownership of the application’s technical design, development, testing and deployment across both iOS and Android platforms, as well as contributing to backend services, APIs and web-facing components that power our loyalty ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively analyse and clarify business requirements with the team, and technical requirements with internal and external system owners.
  • Work closely with relevant system owners to support application integration, investigate and troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems in a timely manner.
  • Take ownership of translating business requirements into user journeys and technical designs for the loyalty programme’s iOS and Android applications, from development, integration, testing to release.
  • Be accountable for the complete testing lifecycle, including preparation of test scenarios and test cases, SIT, regression testing, UAT coordination, defect resolution and production release readiness.
  • Plan quarterly application releases, including submission and deployment through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Monitor and optimise application performance, reliability, responsiveness and user experience.
  • Apply mobile and full stack development best practices relating to coding standards, security, maintainability, version control and release management, covering both client-side and server-side components.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, including system designs, integration specifications, deployment procedures and operational support guides.
  • Use artificial intelligence tools to improve development productivity and automate the generation and execution of test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Liaise with backend API vendors and third-party service providers to review integration specifications, validate API contracts, and ensure backend services reliably support mobile application features, loyalty transactions and member data management.
  • Collaborate on web portal or admin dashboard development where applicable, leveraging frontend frameworks such as React or Vue.js alongside backend technologies (Node.js, Python, or equivalent).
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across mobile, web and backend layers, applying best practices in database design, caching and API versioning.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end mobile and full stack application development. Candidates must demonstrate experience across BOTH iOS and Android mobile platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in React Native or other hybrid mobile development frameworks.
  • Proficiency in full stack development, including backend frameworks (e.g. Node.js, Python/Django, Java Spring Boot) and relational or NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Prior experience working in or building digital solutions for hospitality, loyalty programmes, retail, or consumer lifestyle industries is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containerisation tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is an advantage.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with APIs, backend platforms and third-party systems through conducting technical design, development, SIT and production support.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, data privacy and secure API integration.
  • Experience with source-code management, automated build pipelines and mobile application release processes.
  • Familiarity with Apple and Google Play Store submission, review and deployment processes.
  • Had experience using artificial intelligence tools to generate, automate or maintain test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies is a plus.
  • Able to proactively host collaboration meetings independently with various stakeholders
  • Strong sense of accountability for application quality, stability and successful delivery.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

title: Career Navigator
description:
Goodwill Industries of Hawaii, Inc.

Job Title: Career Navigator

At Goodwill, we do more than provide jobs — we create pathways to opportunity and dignity through the power of work. Our mission-driven culture sets us apart, and every role directly supports individuals in achieving self-sufficiency and success. When you join Goodwill, you're not just building a career — you're changing lives.

So, join the Goodwill Hawaii family and help strengthen our community, one job at a time!

SUMMARY

The Career Navigator supports participants in achieving meaningful employment through individualized career services and job placement assistance. As a Career Navigator, this role provides career counseling, employment preparation, and retention support tailored to participant goals and labor market trends. The Career Navigator also builds relationships with employers and community partners to create job and training opportunities. Ultimately, the Career Navigator helps individuals gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed for lasting career success.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following.

  • Develop employer partnerships to identify job openings and promote participant placement.
  • Assist participants with job search, applications, interviews, and follow-up for job retention.
  • Maintain accurate participant records and ensure compliance with program and confidentiality standards.
  • Collaborate with staff, training providers, and workforce partners to improve outcomes.
  • Participate in professional development, staff meetings, and agency initiatives.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

title: Senior Product Development Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Product Development Engineer

Reports To: Executive Director of Product Innovation

Exempt/Non-Exempt: Exempt

Vaupell designs, engineers, and produces custom, high performance engineered plastic and composite components and assemblies for demanding applications. We are the global market leader in plastic components and assemblies for aircraft interiors while also serving the broader aerospace, defense and medical device & diagnostic markets. Vaupell provides engineered solutions to top tier OEM’s, market-leading growth companies, and promising start-ups. Collaboration with our customers in all phases of the product life cycle results in the highest value solutions that reduce time to market, manage risk and control costs.

Position Purpose:

As a Senior Product Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the complete product life cycle of products for the Aerospace and Defense Industries. Vaupell is looking for a person that will embody the key pillars of the Product Innovation Group: Sustainability, Efficiency and Innovation; to create a “leap” in value of products for our customers. The Senior Product Development Engineer is a key role in the design and development process of products that will redefine the future of the aerospace industry. Aerospace interiors experience required

Responsibilities:

  • Develops, integrates, and documents design requirements to establish part/system design.
  • Designs, analyzes and maintains component and system designs, using CAD tools and/or other design methods, throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Applies design/analysis processes and tools to improve the effectiveness, quality and efficiency of the development effort.
  • Performs feasibility (prototype), functional and qualification testing for component and / or system designs.
  • Investigates emerging technologies to develop concepts for future product designs to meet projected requirements.
  • Transforms initial rough product designs using computer aided design (CAD) into working models and documents.
  • Lead technical reviews including drawing and designs to ensure adherence to established specifications and standards.
  • Designs new products proprietary to Vaupell.

Job Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in an Engineering discipline required
  • 7+ years’ experience as a Product Development Engineer or similar role
  • Aerospace interiors experience required
  • Preferred Floor to Floor aerospace cabin design experience
  • Experience managing complete product life cycle from SOW creation through project gate reviews, qualification (DO-160), FAA certification and delivery of product.
  • Knowledge of CATIA or similar CAD software required

Travel up to 15% may be required.

Environmental Condition

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts and may occasionally be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and vibration. Noise levels in the work environment are typically moderate and may occasionally be loud. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position and to work safely within the environment described above.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the ability to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation. Duties may include frequent standing, walking, and sitting; occasional bending, reaching, lifting, carrying, pushing, climbing, balancing, kneeling, crawling, and twisting; and the use of manual dexterity and other physical abilities necessary to perform job duties safely and effectively. The position may also require handling materials of varying weights, consistent with operational needs.

Vaupell reserves the right to change, modify or add to the Essential Duties and Responsibilities of any position at any time.

Vaupell is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, belief and spirituality, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ethnicity/national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran or disability status.

title: Clinical Team Lead
description:
Clinical Team Lead

  • Salary Range: $33.34 - $46.68 per hour (single license) or $35.00 - $49.00 (dually licensed), based on relevant years of experience
  • Location: Larimer county, Colorado at our Longview campus
  • Status: Full time, 40 hours per week
  • Hours: Wednesday - Saturday 7AM-5:30PM


Employees working at locations operating 24/7 earn a differential. Shift differentials are also available for evenings, nights, weekends and holidays.



Join SummitStone Health Partners as a Clinical Team Lead and help strengthen behavioral health services for the Larimer County community. This role blends clinical supervision, direct client care, team coaching, and collaborative leadership in a supportive, mission-driven environment.


The posted salary range reflects SummitStone’s good faith estimate for this role. Final compensation may vary based on relevant education, training, skills, experience, organizational needs, and the evolving needs of the community we serve.

About the Role


As a Clinical Team Lead, you will help guide the delivery of high-quality mental health and substance use disorder services at the Longview campus. In this role, you will support case managers and Behavioral Health Therapists through individual and group clinical supervision, case consultation, coaching, and day-to-day clinical leadership. You will also provide direct client care and partner with program/site leadership to help the team respond to emerging treatment needs and service changes.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead and support a team of mental health and substance use treatment professionals through coaching, training, and day-to-day guidance.
  • Provide individual and group clinical supervision, case consultation, and thoughtful administrative oversight.
  • Collaborate with site and program leaders to strengthen team operations, support staff, and improve client care.
  • Provide therapy, rehabilitative services, case management, and referrals that help clients move toward their treatment goals.
  • Respond to crisis needs by providing de-escalation, risk assessment, and connection to appropriate resources by phone and in person.
  • Assess client needs, strengths, goals, mental status, and service plans to guide effective care.
  • Coordinate with families, schools, courts, community agencies, and other partners to support each client’s care plan.
  • Help clients build coping skills, problem-solving skills, and daily living supports that promote stability and recovery.
  • Complete clear, timely documentation that supports quality care and meets clinical, organizational, and regulatory standards.


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in counseling, psychology, social work, or a related behavioral health field.
  • Two or more years of post-graduate experience in behavioral health and/or substance use services.


Required Licenses and Certifications

  • Current Colorado professional license in an appropriate discipline, such as LCSW, LPC, LMFT, or LAC.
  • At least three years or 3,000 hours of licensed clinical experience.
  • Eligible to provide clinical supervision under applicable state regulations and SummitStone policy.
  • Valid Colorado driver’s license, or ability to obtain one within 30 days of hire, for roles that require driving. Must maintain a clean driving record. Some roles may include occasional travel to client homes, partner agencies, or community locations and may require safe transportation of clients.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a leadership or supervisory role.
  • Bilingual and/or bicultural experience.


SummitStone considers each applicant’s education, training, skills, experience, and other job-related qualifications in relation to the needs of the role, the organization, and the community we serve. Applicants are encouraged to highlight how their background supports their candidacy.

You’ll have opportunities to grow through company-sponsored training, certifications such as CAT or CAS, and daily collaboration with experienced colleagues. SummitStone also provides clinical supervision toward licensure at no cost to employees and reimburses required licensure fees.

Longview Campus is the new Acute Care Behavioral Health facility which serves Larimer County residents in need of urgent help with mental health and/or substance use disorders. SummitStone has the privilege of partnering closely with Larimer County on this venture. For more information click HERE.

At SummitStone Health Partners, we foster trust, empower recovery, and inspire hope to strengthen and enrich our Northern Colorado community.

We need your help to make this vision a reality.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive environment where everyone can be their authentic self. We welcome team members with a variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences and proudly serve as an equal opportunity employer.

Please visit for more information about who we are.

Total Rewards

Below are some of the benefits we offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage — including options for eligible dependents
  • Mental health and wellness resources
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurances
  • Paid time off (PTO): Accrued vacation and personal leave based on FTE status and length of service
  • Paid Sick Leave: Provided in accordance with the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act (HFWA)
