title: Advanced Practitioner
description:
Summary:

Nurse Practitioner or Physician’s Assistant to provide acute care for Chronic Kidney Disease, Acute Kidney Injury and ESRD patients inpatient hospital setting. Patient population is highly diverse, and resource challenged. Practice includes but is not limited to: physical assessment; ordering, performing, supervising, and interpreting diagnostic and laboratory tests; making diagnoses; initiating and managing treatment plans including, hemodialysis, plasmapheresis, management of pre- and post- renal biopsy orders and interventions, CRRT, peritoneal dialysis, vascular access, prescribing medications and non-pharmacologic treatments in collaboration with MD Nephrologist. Management in partnership with individuals, families, communities to coordinate care, provide counseling and educate. Provide expertise and support to nursing and licensed medical staff caring for patients utilizing best practices and evidence-based care to achieve best possible patient outcomes.

This position is designated as an on-site, patient-facing role. In-office presence is an essential function due to the need for real-time collaboration with providers, direct interaction with patients and caregivers, and secure handling of health data in compliance with HIPAA.

Qualification Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge base, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Qualifications

•Nurse Practitioner: Successful completion of graduate education at the master’s, post-master’s or doctoral level from nationally accredited program, successful national board certification. Master of Science in Advance Practice Nursing (MSN) or Clinical Doctorate in Nursing Practice with preference for FNP, ANP, AGNP or ACNP certification, National Board-Certification Nurse Practitioner (ANCC or AANP) with a valid, unrestricted NC RN license, Initial Nurse Practitioner Approval to Practice and in good standing with the North Carolina Board of Nursing.

•Physician Assistant: Successful completion of an educational program for Physician Assistants accredited by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation, or by its successor agency, and pass the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination administered by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants.

•Hospital experience preferred, but not required

•Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) and ACLS are required and must be maintained.

•Clear criminal history

•Maintenance and engagement in continuing education to remain ahead of technological, methodological and other developments in the field.

•Completion of requirements to maintain a clear and unrestricted license to practice, prior to expiration.

•Valid driver license and reliable transportation to allow individual to provide support to multiple office, hospital and dialysis unit locations as necessary.

•Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications, and familiarization with Electronic Health Records.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

•Maintenance of patient confidentiality and medical records in accordance with HIPAA.

•Ability to practice autonomously and in coordination with healthcare professionals and other individuals.

•Ability to provide a wide range of health care services: diagnosis and management of acute, chronic and complex health problems.

•Comfort with health promotion, disease prevention, health education and counseling.

•General knowledge of health care research methodology and interdisciplinary consultation.

•Strong patient advocacy skills desired.

•Detailed oriented with the ability to speak and write effectively, including the preparation of clear and concise documentation of patient interactions, excellent records maintenance skills.

•Proactive individual with the ability to manage required workload, with strong independent decision-making skills and attention to detail.

•Recognize social determinants which affect health, access to care, and engagement in the healthcare contract between provider and patient.

•Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse resource challenged community.

•Ability to function well while involved in multiple task assignments. Ability to concentrate on details and deal with constant interruption. Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.

•Attendance and completion of in-service training as required.

•Flexibility in scheduling and assignments to meet the needs of the organization.

•Must be proficient in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint software programs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None – However each APP is accountable to patients, their professional organization, state boards and are expected to practice consistently with an ethical code of conduct, evidence-based principles and current practice standards.

Essential Functions:

  • Provide Clinical assessment, and case management including constructing and interpreting medical history, performing physical assessment, evaluating patient behavior, performing, and interpreting selected laboratory tests, identifying problems and developing and implementing treatment plans for acute, chronic kidney disease or end-stage renal disease patients. 70%
  • Order and schedule laboratory studies, diagnostic procedures, and services such as changes in immunosuppression, renal biopsies, inpatient and outpatient dialysis, and home health care; explain necessity, preparation, nature and anticipated effects of scheduled diagnostic and therapeutic procedures to the patients. 10%
  • Seek Expert Opinion or advice of collaborating physician when case falls outside of protocol of agency; refer patients to outside physician for consultation and/or specialized health resources for treatment or clinical management. 5%
  • Documentation of Patient Encounters 10%
  • Other duties as assigned 5%

Physical Demands

•Hearing, visual acuity, talking.

•Extended periods in a stationary or standing position.

•Repetitive motion such as entering data into computer-based programs.

•Applicants should be in good physical health and would be able to traverse across multiple locations within the ECU Health Medical Center campus that may include ramps, uneven sidewalks, elevators, stairs, etc.

Work Environment

Work is normally performed in a typical interior office, hospital, and dialysis medical environment. The noise level is usually moderate. High risk of exposure to blood borne pathogens and OPIM.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the position. All employees may have other duties assigned at any time.

title: Advanced Systems Engineer
description:
Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?


At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

Rincon Research Corporation is seeking an Advanced Systems Engineer to serve on the systems engineering team of an end-to-end development program studying, designing, and deploying advanced orbit determination, maneuver planning and constellation management missions for United States Government space systems. RRC is looking for an exceptional systems engineer to work this program through all phases of development—from early architecture and System Requirements Review (SRR) through Critical Design Review (CDR), integration, testing, and finally deployment into operational systems. In this role, you will work as a system engineer for a complex space domain program.


You will work in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment alongside talented electrical engineers, mathematicians, aerospace engineers, and computer scientists/engineers. At RRC, systems engineers are involved across the entire system lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, operations, and sustainment—receiving direct feedback from customers and seeing their work make a tangible, real-world impact. Innovation is expected: team members are encouraged to propose improvements to system architectures, engineering processes, tools, and security posture.


Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

What are the primary responsibilities in the Advanced Systems Engineer position?


System Architecture & Technical Leadership

Help define and evolve the overall system architecture, ensuring coherence across subsystems, interfaces, and mission phases

Assist in balancing performance, risk, cost, schedule, and margin in system-level decisions and trade studies

Resolve cross-discipline technical issues and elevate critical risks or trades to program leadership as needed

Requirements, Verification & Risk Management

Participate in system requirements definition, allocation, traceability, and change control across the program lifecycle

Establish system-level verification and validation strategies aligned with mission objectives

Maintain system technical risks, margins, and mitigation plans

Use CAMEO or similar software product to help design, analyze and manage the technical program

Program Technical Execution

Support system-level technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, and CDR

Integration, Test & Customer Interface

Help define and oversee system integration, test, and verification activities

Serve as a technical interface to the customer, presenting architectures, design decisions, and technical status

Support pre-deployment testing, launch preparation, commissioning, and anomaly resolution, as applicable

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies, applying them when beneficial

Work across the full mission lifecycle from development through operations and proactively recommend improvements

Operate independently with minimal supervision and a strong sense of ownership


A key duty is staying current with the latest technologies, tools, and methodologies, as well as experimenting with new technologies to bring innovative solutions into RRC projects. RRC team members can expect to work across all functional areas: systems engineering, development, integration and testing, deployment and operations & maintenance, gaining direct mission feedback from customers and seeing your work make a meaningful impact. You are encouraged and expected to suggest improvements for the projects you work on. The ability to work independently with minimal supervision and to self-initiator is essential.



What required background will make you successful?

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance
  • US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or related discipline)
  • 7+ years of progressive systems engineering experience with demonstrated success performing the responsibilities listed above
  • Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies and tools (CAMEO)
  • Proven track record of leading SRR, PDR, and CDR for complex systems
  • Demonstrated experience carrying a space system from early concept through integration, test, and system-level verification


Preferred skills:

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related discipline
  • Direct, hands-on experience developing and deploying space systems
  • Direct experience working with DoD, DoW, and/or Intelligence Community customers
  • Familiarity with signal processing architectures and/or orbit determination/planning
  • Proficiency with systems engineering and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama, Cradle)
  • Experience serving as a prime contractor technical lead on space development programs
  • Professional certifications (e.g., INCOSE CSEP, PMP)
  • Experience supporting launch operations, early orbit operations, or anomaly resolution

Where is the position located?

This position can be located at our Centennial, CO; Colorado Springs, CO; or Chantilly, VA locations.

*The likely salary range for this position is $170,000 to $190,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

What benefits does RRC offer?

  • 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD)
  • Flexible reimbursement spending accounts for medical expense and dependent care
  • Immediate participation and vesting in the company’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) Plan
  • Employer contributions to RRC’s ESOP
  • Employer matching contributions to the company’s 401( k) Plan
  • Employer discretionary contributions to the company’s 401(k) Plan

title: Account Supervisor - H+H, NYC/Bellevue
description:
At Surgical Solutions, we are redefining surgical support services by delivering expert, behind-the-scenes solutions that drive surgical excellence, improve patient care, and empower clinical teams. As a trusted partner to hospitals and healthcare systems nationwide, we offer unmatched expertise in sterile processing, surgical instrumentation, and operating room support—allowing clinicians to focus on what matters most: the patient.


We are looking for a dynamic Account Supervisor to lead one or more hospital sites, serve as the primary liaison with hospital leadership, and oversee daily operations and team performance. This is a key leadership role that blends people management, clinical excellence, and operational efficiency in the fast-paced world of surgical services.

Account Supervisor – Role Summary

As an Account Supervisor, you’ll be the operational and strategic point of contact for one or more hospitals. You’ll lead a team of Surgical Solutions Technicians, ensuring the highest levels of service, compliance, and performance. This role is a balanced mix of team leadership, customer relationship management, and hands-on support within the operating room environment. Reporting to the Account Manager, you’ll work closely with hospital staff and Surgical Solutions leadership to ensure seamless delivery of services every single day.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Prepare accurate reports, invoices, and provide operations and finance data as needed.

Clinical & Support

  • Be a hands-on leader in a clinical setting, providing direct assistance during surgical procedures.
  • Support pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative functions, ensuring smooth turnover and timely preparation.
  • Set up and maintain surgical equipment, troubleshoot issues, and ensure video systems function properly.
  • Manage equipment repairs, maintenance, and vendor coordination.
  • Maintain sterile field integrity and adhere to high standards in decontamination, sterilization, and instrument processing.
  • Serve as a technical backup as needed to ensure uninterrupted coverage and service.

Surgical Cost Management Platform (SCMP) & Technology Use

  • Maintain up-to-date, real-time entries in SCMP, ensuring complete and accurate case documentation.
  • Oversee site-wide adoption of digital tools, train team members, and ensure 98%+ usage compliance.

  • Embrace new technologies and ensure team readiness in all system rollouts and updates.

Required Skills & Attributes

  • Strong leadership presence with proven ability to manage and develop teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Outstanding organizational and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to liaise confidently with clinicians and executives.
  • High emotional intelligence with a respectful, empathetic approach to team management.
  • Reliable, punctual, and committed to consistent on-site presence during standard and rotating shifts.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing meaningfully as part of a high-performance team.
  • Physical stamina for long periods of standing and movement; ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Certification: CRCST required (Surgical Solutions will support certification if not currently held).
  • Experience:
    • 4+ years of frontline supervisory experience
    • 4+ years of clinical setting or surgical services experience
    • Prior experience managing 2–15 direct reports
    • ERP system experience a plus
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel); digital reporting and case tracking systems experience preferred.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Availability for 24/7 hospital operations, including weekend and holiday rotations.

This role is paid on an annual basis ranging from $65,000 - $75,000, depending on experience and qualifications. This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

title: Inventory Control Specialist
description:
Summary: The Inventory Control Specialist is responsible for overseeing inventory accuracy, transaction integrity, and inventory control processes within the warehouse and manufacturing operation. This role coordinates cycle count programs, investigates inventory discrepancies, and ensures inventory records accurately reflect physical stock. The Inventory Control Specialist collaborates with production, purchasing, logistics, and finance teams to maintain optimal inventory levels and support operational objectives. This position with report to the Logistics Manager

Essential Functions of the Job: The essential functions of this job require the person, with or without reasonable accommodation, to perform the following:

Inventory Management

  • Supervise daily inventory control activities and inventory personnel.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records within the ERP/WMS system.
  • Monitor inventory transactions including receipts, transfers, issues, returns, and adjustments.
  • Ensure compliance with inventory control procedures and company policies.
  • Review inventory levels and identify excess, obsolete, or slow-moving inventory.

Cycle Counting & Audits

  • Develop and manage cycle count schedules.
  • Conduct and oversee physical inventories and annual inventory audits.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and determine root causes.
  • Implement corrective actions to improve inventory accuracy.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy targets and reporting metrics.
  • Train others on cycle count process and inventory control

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve inventory processes and warehouse efficiency.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives related to inventory accuracy and material flow.
  • Develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Purchasing, Production Planning, Manufacturing, Shipping, Receiving, and Finance teams.
  • Support inventory reconciliation and month-end closing activities.
  • Coordinate disposition of nonconforming, obsolete, or excess materials.

Recommended Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in a related field; or minimum five years related experience; or combination of education and related experience.

title: Post Doctoral Resident
description:
NBI is nationally and internationally recognized as a leading psychological assessment, treatment, and training center. Postdoctoral residents at NBI have the opportunity to work with patients of all ages with anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and related disorders, autism, and other conditions, individually and in groups. NBI offers an intensive outpatient program (IOP), a Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP), a supportive residential setting, and Comprehensive Care Plans. Clinical behavior analysis (CBA), executive function training, and nutritional guidance are also among our services. During their clinical residency, postdoctoral residents will gain experience in Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), including exposure and response prevention (ERP), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), and acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), as well as participate in a collaborative team approach, outreach, and program development.

Application Qualifications:

All Residents must have completed a doctoral degree in Clinical Psychology from an APA-accredited academic program before beginning the post-doctoral residency.

All Residents must have completed 2,000 hours in an APA-accredited pre-doctoral internship in Psychology prior to the start of the residency year.

Residents with a specific interest in the treatment of neurobiological conditions and/or prior clinical training or research experience with these populations will be preferred.

Residents who have prior experience or training in Cognitive Behavioral treatments are encouraged to apply.

COMPENSATION: 52k + 2k in continuing education plus benefits (vacation days, federal holidays, health insurance, dental, vision, professional training time, licensing exam release time, and 401K after one year of employment). NBI's postdoctoral training program is a current member of the Association of Psychology Postdoctoral and Internship Centers (APPIC)

Application Process:

Please submit the following materials by the application deadline.

Statement of interest indicating goals for the post-doctoral residency and long-term career plans

Curriculum vitae

Letters of reference from three doctoral-level professionals who previously supervised or have had experience with the applicant’s training

Letter from the applicant’s internship Training Director that an APA-accredited internship will be completed prior to the desired start date of the residency program

Letter from the applicant’s graduate Training Director that the applicant’s doctoral degree has been awarded or that the dissertation defense is scheduled prior to the start date of the residency program

Graduate transcripts

Copies of relevant publications

title: Quality Inspector
description:

Position Purpose

The Quality Inspector is responsible for conducting inspections and testing against product/part engineering requirements and/or customer specifications/procedures to ensure quality manufactured parts.

Essential Duties and responsibilities

  • Verify that all components and labeling are present, correct, and in good condition as per the work order.
  • Inspect parts using handheld measurement tools, test equipment, and visual techniques.
  • Notify the appropriate personnel immediately upon identifying a non-conformance.
  • Perform first part, in-process, and final inspection.
  • Process parts physically and electronically per procedure and generate non-conformance reports for discrepant parts.
  • Accept and/or reject parts based on documentation.
  • Assure that inspection equipment calibration is current.
  • Assist in Investigating apparent non-conformities.
  • Complete documentation including the use of ERPMRB activities and investigate further as necessary.
  • Operate quality measuring machinery, i.e. CMMs and Vision systems.
  • Responsible to follow all Vaupell policies and procedures, standard operating procedures and safety practices.
  • Other duties as assigned

Job Qualifications/Requirements

  • High School Diploma or general education degree(GED)
  • Minimum of 1-year relevant experience.
  • Math aptitude to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Understanding ISO and cGMP requirements.
  • Knowledgeable in use of verniers, calipers, and other similar inspection equipment is required.
  • Basic blueprint reading is required.
  • The uncorrected or corrected vision shall be equal or better than the following:
    • Distance Vision: 20/25
    • Vision at 14 inches: Jaeger Number1 or 2 based on location
    • Color Vision Normal
  • Ability to read, speak, understand and follow instructions in English.
  • Must be able to wear and properly use the required personal protective equipment.

Candidates must be a “US Person” (i.e. US Citizen or Permanent Resident) to ensure Vaupell's compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) and EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

Environmental Condition

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and vibrations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to occasionally loud. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the ability to occasionally stand, walk, sit, bend at the waist, reach below and above shoulder level, lift and carry up to 50 pounds, push under 25 pounds, climb stairs, balance, kneel, pull, and use fine motor skills such as grasping, handling, finger dexterity, feeling, and eye-hand or eye-hand-foot coordination. The role also requires frequent ordinary hearing, near and far visual acuity, depth perception, and keyboarding to support administrative and quality-related tasks. Requirements such as lifting or carrying over 50 pounds, pushing 25 pounds or more, climbing ladders, crawling, turning or twisting, color perception, and other physical demands are not applicable unless otherwise directed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Breaking News Reporter
description:
About the Daily Beast

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month.

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a dynamic and dedicated Breaking News Reporter to join our news team.

About the Role

The Breaking News Reporter will cover fast-moving stories across national news, politics, entertainment, celebrity, media, sports, and world affairs. The ideal candidate has strong news judgment, a high news metabolism, and the ability to stay a half-step ahead of the competition.

This reporter should be equally comfortable turning around clean, compelling copy on deadline and developing original reporting through interviews, sources, public records, and exclusive details. We’re looking for someone who can identify emerging stories, find the most compelling angle, and write with the wit, authority, and punch that distinguish The Daily Beast.

Candidates should have professional reporting experience and clips that demonstrate speed, accuracy, strong writing, and original reporting.

This position includes weekend shifts.

What You'll Do:

· Contribute to breaking news coverage.

· Report and write news items on deadline.

· Spot emerging stories before they dominate national headlines.

· Identify and pitch stories that matter to our audience and write intelligent, exciting copy with a punchy attitude that separates us from other outlets.

· Produce clean, concise and accurate copy in a breaking news environment that requires a fast pace and can-do attitude.

· Be able to locate original sources for stories and be comfortable making calls, creating sources and conducting interviews if necessary.

· Be comfortable writing across a variety of topics including U.S. politics, world news, entertainment, sports, and media.

· An understanding of the Daily Beast’s voice and dynamic tone.

Qualifications

· Minimum of three years writing and reporting news for a national or large regional newspaper, website or TV station.

· Proven work ability in a fast-paced environment, juggling multiple projects and deadlines.

· Willingness to collaborate with other reporters and editors.

· Strong writing and reporting skills.

· Immaculate general knowledge of the news, and especially of the political scene.

· A self-starter who can conceive and execute stories with impact.

· Ability to take initiative, receive constructive feedback, and work with minimal supervision.

· Demonstrated capacity to work well in a team environment.

· Availability to work a schedule that includes weekends.

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high ends of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location, experience, performance, and other factors.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? If you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you’re just the right candidate for this or other roles. See more about our commitment to diversity at

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Audio Conferencing Operator
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking highly detail-oriented and client-focused Audio-Conferencing Operators to support Annual General Meetings (AGMs), Virtual Shareholder Meetings (VSMs), and other high-profile financial events. This role combines ingest coordination and live meeting moderation, requiring precision, composure under pressure, and exceptional communication skills.

Operators will serve as the first point of contact for participants dialing into events and will play a critical role in ensuring seamless meeting execution—from participant onboarding through live moderation and Q&A management.


Key Responsibilities

1. Ingest & Participant Coordination

  • Manage inbound calls from attendees, executives, board members, and stakeholders
  • Accurately identify and verify participants, including correct name pronunciation and titles
  • Route participants to the correct meeting, bridge, or breakout room
  • Provide clear, professional instructions to ensure smooth entry into events
  • Maintain real-time awareness of participant flow and meeting readiness
  • Troubleshoot connection issues (dial-in, audio clarity, routing errors) quickly and effectively
  • Ensure accuracy and speed when handling participant movements

2. Pre-Event Preparation & Post-Event Wrap

  • Review run-of-show documents and client scripts ahead of events
  • Conduct pre-call checks with speakers and stakeholders
  • Confirm participant lists and special handling requirements
  • Support post-event reporting, including incident notes and feedback

3. Live Meeting Moderation

  • Lead meetings with scripted introductions in a confident and professional manner
  • Act as the primary liaison between speakers, presenters, and production teams
  • Manage speaker queues and ensure smooth transitions during live events
  • Handle all Q&A workflows:
    • Screen and organize incoming questions
    • Prioritize and route questions appropriately per client list
  • Take meetings live and manage timing cues with precision

4. Real-Time Event Execution

  • Operate in high-pressure, high-volume environments with multiple concurrent events
  • Monitor live call quality and escalate issues when needed
  • Maintain strict adherence to run-of-show (ROS) and event timelines
  • Execute contingency plans when technical or participant issues arise

5. Client & Stakeholder Interaction

  • Deliver white-glove service to C-suite executives, investors, and institutional clients
  • Communicate clearly and professionally across all participant levels
  • Build confidence with clients through composure, accuracy, and responsiveness
  • Coordinate closely with internal delivery, production, and technical teams

6. Compliance, Accuracy & Documentation

  • Ensure all participant data (names, titles, affiliations) is accurate and properly formatted
  • Follow compliance protocols for financial and shareholder communications
  • Always maintain confidentiality and data security standards
  • Document key event notes, issues, and resolutions for post-event reporting


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience in audio conferencing, webcast moderation, or live event operations
  • Strong understanding of AGMs, earnings calls, or financial event workflows (preferred)
  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with clear, professional delivery
  • Ability to manage high call volumes with speed and accuracy
  • Strong attention to detail, especially with names, titles, and participant routing
  • Experience interacting with executive-level stakeholders
  • Ability to remain calm and composed under pressure
  • Strong multitasking and prioritization skills


Technical Experience (Preferred)

  • Audio conferencing platforms (e.g., TurboBridge, Webex, Zoom, Teams)
  • Q&A moderation tools and workflows
  • Familiarity with dial-in systems, bridges, and participant routing
  • Basic troubleshooting of audio and connectivity issues


Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Communication & Professional Presence
  • Speed & Execution Under Pressure
  • Customer Focus / White-Glove Service
  • Adaptability in Live Environments #LI-OE

title: Revenue Planning & Intelligence
description:
About defi SOLUTIONS:

It’s an exciting time to join defi!


defi SOLUTIONS is a pioneer in end-to-end, SaaS loan originations, servicing, and managed servicing solutions. Our customers include the highest-volume captive auto lenders, banks, credit unions, and finance companies in North America. We have more than three decades of experience helping lenders reduce time-to-market, streamline operations, and customize lending processes with proven, scalable performance.

Position Purpose:

This position sits within Portfolio Management and blends data analytics with revenue planning to help defi plan, forecast, and deliver against its business strategy. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between data, financial models, and business systems to turn information into decisions leadership can act on.

This role will own and evolve defi's revenue forecasting practice, helping leadership see further ahead while strengthening the accuracy of the data and systems the reporting depends on. The right candidate will build an analytical foundation that leadership can plan around with confidence.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Monitor in-month revenue pacing across active engagements to flag items that may need attention before period close.
  • Support the team's monthly revenue reconciliation process, synthesizing timesheet, contract, and billing data into a reliable estimate of monthly performance.
  • Advance profitability planning from a supporting function into a core discipline — helping ensure client engagements are consistently delivered in a profitable, efficient, and reliable manner through rigorous margin analysis and reporting.

  • Track how effectively services work attaches to broader product relationships, and benchmark the practice's performance against external industry standards to maintain competitiveness.
  • Support governance and process consistency around capitalizable-work tracking, in partnership with project teams.
  • Build relationships with client and delivery stakeholders to inform planning and forecasting.
  • Partner with Sales and other cross-functional teams to translate data into decisions that leadership can act on.
  • Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Required Qualifications/ Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5–8 years of experience in business/data analytics, revenue operations, or planning & analysis, ideally within a technology or services-oriented business.
  • Advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, complex formulas) and experience with BI/reporting tools such as Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of revenue and margin concepts sufficient to support profitability analysis.
  • Experience building or maintaining revenue forecasts in a subscription, project, or services-based business.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or a similar PPM/ITSM platform, including how project, task, and billing data flows through the system.
  • Demonstrated experience with project/portfolio management practices and the technology delivery lifecycle (waterfall and/or agile).
  • Demonstrated understanding of revenue accounting treatment and software capitalization concepts as applied in a technology or services business.


Preferred Qualifications/ Skills:

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to streamline reporting and forecasting work; willingness to build fluency quickly is a plus even without prior experience.


Competencies:

  • Strong data literacy — able to work confidently with data structures and schemas without needing to be a database administrator.
  • Ability to build collaborative, engaged relationships across Delivery, Sales, Finance, and client-facing teams.
  • Ability to translate complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready communication for senior leadership.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities and ambiguous, evolving scope without direct supervision.

title: Seasonal Laundry Attendant
description:
Seasonal Laundry Attendant

About The Fall Line

The Fall Line is a premier private destination golf and sporting club located in Southwest Georgia. Our club offers state-of-the-art facilities, including two Ogilvy, Cocking and Mead–designed 18-hole golf courses, a 9-hole short course, and world-class facilities for shooting, hunting, and angling. In addition to our outstanding outdoor offerings, we pride ourselves on exceptional hospitality, with multiple dining and lodging options, all enhanced by our 25-acre farm that serves as the centerpiece of our 4,500-acre property.

Position Summary

The Seasonal Full-Time Laundry Attendant is responsible for the timely cleaning, processing, organization, and distribution of linens, towels, uniforms, and other washable items used throughout the Club.

This position requires strong attention to detail, efficiency, and a commitment to maintaining The Fall Line’s standards for cleanliness and presentation. The Laundry Attendant will also augment the Housekeeping team when needed, including assisting with guest accommodations, common areas, turndown service, and other housekeeping responsibilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Sort, wash, dry, fold, press, and properly store linens, towels, uniforms, and other Club laundry.
  • Inspect items for stains, damage, excessive wear, or other quality concerns.
  • Treat stains and process laundry according to established procedures and manufacturer instructions.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels of clean linens, towels, and laundry supplies.
  • Distribute clean items to guest accommodations, housekeeping storage areas, dining operations, locker rooms, and other Club locations.
  • Collect soiled laundry and transport it safely to designated laundry areas.
  • Operate washers, dryers, irons, presses, and other laundry equipment safely and properly.
  • Keep the laundry room, equipment, shelving, carts, and storage areas clean, organized, and sanitary.
  • Follow proper procedures for handling chemicals, cleaning products, and soiled materials.
  • Communicate equipment problems, supply shortages, damaged items, and inventory concerns promptly.
  • Assist the Housekeeping team with cleaning guest accommodations, common areas, offices, restrooms, and other Club facilities when needed.
  • Assist with turndown service, room preparation, linen changes, restocking, and special housekeeping projects.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to requests from members, guests, and Club leadership.
  • Protect member and guest privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times.
  • Work cooperatively with Housekeeping, Food and Beverage, Golf Operations, and other departments to support Club operations.
  • Complete other duties as assigned based on operational needs.

Schedule

Full-time shifts are available between 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m. Schedules may vary based on Club operations, member usage, and departmental needs. Evening, weekend, and holiday availability may be required.

Qualifications

  • Previous laundry, housekeeping, hospitality, hotel, resort, or private club experience is preferred but not required.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, and complete assignments within established timelines.
  • Professional appearance, communication, and conduct.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Willingness to work cross-functionally and assist outside the laundry area when needed.
  • Availability to work shifts between 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m., including evenings, weekends, and holidays as scheduled.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, reach, push, pull, kneel, and perform repetitive movements.
  • Ability to lift and carry laundry bags, linen bundles, supplies, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to push and maneuver loaded laundry and housekeeping carts.
  • Ability to work in warm, humid, and fast-paced laundry and housekeeping environments.
  • Ability to use cleaning chemicals and laundry products safely.

Work Environment

This position primarily works in the Club’s laundry and housekeeping areas but may also work in guest accommodations, dining facilities, locker rooms, offices, and other indoor or outdoor Club locations. The position may be exposed to heat, humidity, cleaning chemicals, wet surfaces, and varying noise levels.

Seasonal Full-Time Employment

This is a seasonal full-time position, generally supporting the Club’s operating season from September through June. Work schedules and weekly hours are based on Club usage, business levels, weather, events, and operational needs.

Drug-Free Workplace

The Fall Line is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy, and drug-free workplace. As a condition of employment, applicants who receive a conditional offer may be required to successfully complete a drug screening. Employees are also subject to drug and alcohol testing in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

title: Overhaul Quality Inspector (Level I)
description:
Your Role


As a Quality Inspector, you will be responsible for performing visual and dimensional inspections of customer-owned parts throughout all stages of production. You will ensure compliance with manufacturer engine manuals, FAA/EASA regulations, customer requirements, and internal procedures.


This role plays a critical part in maintaining quality standards, ensuring accurate documentation, and supporting the safe and compliant delivery of aerospace components.


What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

  • Perform visual and dimensional inspection of incoming customer-owned parts in accordance with Manufacturer Engine Manuals, purchase orders, repair tickets, and internal traveler documentation
  • Prepare Overhaul/Repair (O/R) teardown documentation and verify completion of required signoffs, dates, and stamps
  • Conduct in-process inspections of customer-owned parts following Manufacturer Engine Manuals and internal traveler requirements
  • Review traveler and teardown documentation for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform final inspections of completed parts to ensure compliance with Manufacturer Engine Manuals, approved teardown sheets, and customer requirements
  • Verify all documentation is complete with required approvals and traceability
  • Inspect all supplier-provided and internally produced details in accordance with Manufacturer Engine Manuals, operation sheets, and FAA/customer-approved repair procedures
  • Assemble, verify, and maintain all gauges required for production inspection activities
  • Maintain and control inspection stamps in accordance with documented quality procedures
  • Review and approve purchase orders related to shippable product
  • Maintain accurate, neat quality records and a clean, organized work environment
  • Support quality and production teams with additional duties as required

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation including:
    • Blueprint Reading
    • Operation sheets
    • Travelers
    • Manufacturer Engine Manuals and related publications
    • FAA/EASA regulations and requirements
  • Blueprint reading
  • Proficiency in using relevant computer systems, inspection tools, and measurement equipment
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and technical skills

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience in aerospace inspection
  • Familiarity with borescope inspection, CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machines), and precision measurement tools
  • Experience working in regulated environments (FAA, EASA, aerospace manufacturing)
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform physical activities including sitting, standing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally up to 50 pounds with assistance
  • Visual requirements include:
    • Close vision
    • Distance vision
    • Color vision
    • Peripheral vision
    • Depth perception and ability to adjust focus

Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful completion of:

  • Drug and alcohol screening
  • Background check

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • Being part of a high-precision aerospace environment focused on quality and compliance
  • Work with advanced inspection tools and technical documentation
  • Contribute to safety-critical components in the aviation industry
  • Collaborate with skilled technicians and quality professionals

Pre-Employment Requirements

  • Background check
  • Drug and alcohol screening

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.
Our goal is to maintain a respectful, inclusive workplace where skilled professionals can build long‑term careers while continuing our tradition of aerospace excellence.

title: Employment Specialist II - WAC
description:
Employment Specialist II

About Young Community Developers

Established in 1973, YCD is a nonprofit organization who serves residents of all ages living in the most historically underserved communities of San Francisco. YCD takes a holistic approach via a delivery eco-system of services designed to empower residents in achieving economic mobility, in turn building and sustaining a positive community by providing them with education opportunities, workforce development training, and social services. YCD’s philosophy is that every individual should have the right to sustainable and generational economic mobility, aiming to break the cycle of poverty. Each year YCD provides around 1,200 community members with employment and training services through their programs and partnerships. YCD is also proud to share that they have been voted by Non-Profit Times as one of the top 50 best nonprofits of its size to work for in the United States!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Employment Specialist II is a mid-level member of the Workforce Access Center (WAC) team with demonstrated experience in workforce development, employment services, and case management. This position manages a diverse caseload of approximately 60 to 100 participants annually across Rapid Response and Layoff, Restorative, and Intensive service tiers.

The Employment Specialist II conducts participant assessments, develops individualized employment plans, provides career coaching, delivers job-readiness workshops, coordinates supportive services, and assists participants with securing and retaining employment or enrolling in sector-based training.

The Employment Specialist II works with moderate independence, collaborates with employers and community partners, and contributes to service delivery across YCD career pathways. This position reports directly to the WAC Director.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct participant intake, eligibility screening, orientation, and comprehensive employment-readiness assessments

• Develop individualized employment plans with clear goals, activities, while maintaining consistent communication with participants documenting progress toward employment & training goals and provide retention follow-up at 30-, 90-, and 180-day

• Assist participants with job searches, online applications, resumes, cover letters, interviewing, and employment-related communication along with preparation for job fairs and hiring events

• Collaborate with YCD departments, administrative staff, program leadership, Job Developers, employers, training providers, and partners to support referrals, interviews, placements, and retention and refer qualified and job-ready participants for employment opportunities

• Coordinate referrals for transportation, housing, childcare, legal services, mental health services, identification documents, work attire, technology access, and other assistance to manage possible barriers

• Apply trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and participant-centered practices

• Facilitate individual & group job-readiness workshops/other topics independently

• Adapt content for different educational levels, employment backgrounds, learning styles, and technology skills

• Incorporate responsible use of AI tools into job-readiness instruction while emphasizing accuracy, privacy, and professional judgment

• Develop and maintain relationships with employers, training providers, educational institutions, community organizations, and public agencies to remain informed about current job openings, occupational requirements, and emerging career opportunities

• Represent YCD and WAC professionally in meetings, events, and community settings and promote WAC services to prospective participants, employers, and partners

• Accurately enter and maintain participant information in Workforce Central, Salesforce, and all required systems using confidential record keeping practices

• Complete timely case notes documenting services, progress, referrals, barriers, and follow-up while maintaining complete and organized electronic and physical case files

• Ensure compliance with OEWD, YCD, grant, contractual, and program requirements while participating in monitoring, quality-assurance, audit, and corrective-action processes

• Track progress toward enrollment, service, training, referral, placement, supportive-service, and retention goals along with contributing to monthly, quarterly, and grant-related reporting

• Participate in professional development, program planning, and continuous-improvement activities, local travel and occasional evening or weekend work may be required for employer visits, outreach and local events, program activities, etc

• Valid California driver’s license and reliable transportation required

• Perform other related duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in workforce development, social services, or a related field preferred; 2-4 years of relevant experience in workforce development, case management, recruiting, social services, or a related field may be considered in place of a degree

• Demonstrated experience managing a caseload, conducting assessments, developing individualized plans, and maintaining accurate case documentation.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate employment-readiness workshops with moderate supervision

• Experience helping individuals overcome employment barriers and access supportive services

• Strong interpersonal, written, organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, educational, socioeconomic, and employment backgrounds

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace

• Strong commitment to YCD mission and the communities it serves

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of San Francisco workforce-development, education, training, and supportive-service systems

• Familiarity with OEWD-funded programs and workforce performance requirements

• Experience serving people affected by unemployment, layoffs, homelessness, justice-system involvement, economic instability, or other barriers

• Familiarity with construction, healthcare, security, technology, transportation, hospitality, or other high-demand sectors

• Working knowledge of Salesforce, Workforce Central, or comparable systems preferred

• Bilingual or bicultural capacity in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or another San Francisco threshold language

LOCATION: 150 Executive Park Blvd.

JOB TYPE: Full Time; Exempt

SUPERVISORY: No

COMPENSATION: $70,304-$70,500

title: Sr. Systems Engineer
description:
Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?


At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

Rincon Research Corporation is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to serve as the systems engineering lead of an end-to-end development program studying, designing, and deploying advanced orbit determination, maneuver planning and constellation management missions for United States Government space systems. RRC is looking for an exceptional systems engineering leader to guide this program through all phases of development—from early architecture and System Requirements Review (SRR) through Critical Design Review (CDR), integration, testing, and finally deployment into operational systems. In this role, you will work with other team leads to serve as a lead system engineer for a complex space program. As a small business, RRC offers a unique opportunity to combine hands-on technical depth with senior-level leadership, allowing you to remain deeply engaged in detailed design and engineering decisions while helping to guide the overall program.


You will work in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment alongside talented electrical engineers, mathematicians, aerospace engineers, and computer scientists/engineers. At RRC, systems engineers are involved across the entire system lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, operations, and sustainment—receiving direct feedback from customers and seeing their work make a tangible, real-world impact. Innovation is expected: team members are encouraged to propose improvements to system architectures, engineering processes, tools, and security posture.


Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

What are the primary responsibilities in the Sr. Systems Engineer position?


System Architecture & Technical Leadership

Define and evolve the overall system architecture, ensuring coherence across subsystems, interfaces, and mission phases

Balance performance, risk, cost, schedule, and margin in system-level decisions and trade studies

Resolve cross-discipline technical issues and elevate critical risks or trades to program leadership as needed

Requirements, Verification & Risk Management

Participate in system requirements definition, allocation, traceability, and change control across the program lifecycle

Establish system-level verification and validation strategies aligned with mission objectives

Maintain system technical risks, margins, and mitigation plans

Program Technical Execution

Support system-level technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, and CDR

Integration, Test & Customer Interface

Define and oversee system integration, test, and verification activities

Serve as a technical interface to the customer, presenting architectures, design decisions, and technical status

Support pre-deployment testing, launch preparation, commissioning, and anomaly resolution, as applicable

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies, applying them when beneficial

Work across the full mission lifecycle from development through operations and proactively recommend improvements

Operate independently with minimal supervision and a strong sense of ownership


A key duty is staying current with the latest technologies, tools, and methodologies, as well as experimenting with new technologies to bring innovative solutions into RRC projects. RRC team members can expect to work across all functional areas: systems engineering, development, integration and testing, deployment and operations & maintenance, gaining direct mission feedback from customers and seeing your work make a meaningful impact. You are encouraged and expected to suggest improvements for the projects you work on. The ability to work independently with minimal supervision and to self-initiator is essential.



What required background will make you successful?

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance
  • US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or related discipline)
  • 10+ years of progressive systems engineering experience with demonstrated success performing the responsibilities listed above
  • Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies and tools (CAMEO)
  • Direct, hands-on experience developing and deploying space systems
  • Proven track record of leading SRR, PDR, and CDR for complex systems
  • Demonstrated experience carrying a space system from early concept through integration, test, and system-level verification
  • Proficiency with systems engineering and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama, Cradle)


Preferred skills:

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Systems Engineering or related discipline
  • Direct experience working with DoD, DoW, and/or Intelligence Community customers
  • Familiarity with signal processing architectures and/or orbit determination/planning
  • Experience serving as a prime contractor technical lead on space development programs
  • Professional certifications (e.g., INCOSE CSEP, PMP)
  • Experience supporting launch operations, early orbit operations, or anomaly resolution

Where is the position located?

This position is located at our Centennial, CO office.

*The likely salary range for this position is $222,000 to $242,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

What benefits does RRC offer?

  • 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD)
  • Flexible reimbursement spending accounts for medical expense and dependent care
  • Immediate participation and vesting in the company’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) Plan
  • Employer contributions to RRC’s ESOP
  • Employer matching contributions to the company’s 401( k) Plan
  • Employer discretionary contributions to the company’s 401(k) Plan


Rincon Research Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

Job Purpose

The Residential Mortgage Consultant solicits residential mortgage and home equity loan business to meet defined production objectives. The Consultant will develop and nurture an extensive network of mortgage loan referral sources including retail branch partners, realtors, builders and other center-of-influence professionals (CPA’s, Attorney, Financial Planners). They will also be an active member of the community in which they live or work and will provide consumer education, product knowledge and support to promote homeownership within their community.

The Mortgage Consultant will understand all of the residential mortgage and home equity products the bank offers and will understand, and remain current, on the regulations (Regulation Z, Regulation B, Home Mortgage Disclosure Act, RESPA etc.) governing the mortgage lending industry. As a trusted professional to the home loan applicant, they will provide exceptional customer service through all stages of the loan decision cycle from initial interview through application, loan processing and loan closing. They will provide individual attention to each applicant to understand their mortgage lending needs and provide recommendations accordingly. The Mortgage Consultant has the responsibility of gathering the borrower’s personal information (in-person, telephone, on-line, or e-mail) and inputting it into the bank’s loan origination system.

The Mortgage Consultant will further assist customers by identifying and understanding their needs for non-mortgage bank products. Relying on their established internal partner network and through the use of the banks sales referral system, the Mortgage Consultant will facilitate referrals to other lines of business.

Job Duties

  • Consistently meet or exceeds established production, referral, and customer satisfaction objectives
  • Meet with prospective borrowers to discuss lending options, review the borrowers financial and credit information, and present mortgage loan products
  • Responsible for offering the best possible customer experience as well as providing guidance on product options
  • Enter complete and thorough application information into the loan origination system
  • Contact the applicant to collect all supporting documentation required for a complete loan package and uploading into the loan origination system as necessary
  • Actively communicate with prospective borrowers during the application process either in person, by phone, or electronically. Manage loan pipeline, proactively keeping borrowers up to date on the status of their loan request
  • Serve as trusted advisor to other lines of business by attending market team meetings and by participating in joint sales call efforts
  • Collaborate with the loan fulfillment team to ensure key process milestones are met, regulations are adhered to and the loan is processed efficiently
  • Uncover client financial needs through the mortgage interview process and make referrals through the sales referral system
  • Contact all incoming mortgage referrals and keep sales referral system up to date
  • Demonstrates initiative in developing a broad referral network of retail partners, realtors and other professionals/centers of influence; may involve cold-calling and/or prospecting
  • Participate in community activities/organizations that promote the bank and homeownership, including hosting or presenting first-time home buyer or home ownership principles seminars to agencies or members of the community
  • Attends and participates in Consumer Lending meetings as required by management
  • Supports other Mortgage Consultants as necessary
  • Will perform special projects as assigned

Education, Experience and Job Skills

Applicant must have strong sales ability, computer skill sets appropriate for the job, and the ability to obtain their NMLS license.

  • 2 year college degree required, Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills and proven ability to manage a dynamic pipeline
  • Excellent communication skills, experience in public speaking preferred
  • Ability to comprehend and analyze complex personal financial information
  • Good computer skills
  • 5 years of residential mortgage lending or commensurate sales experience S.A.F.E. Act registration at the time of employment through the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS). The NMLS web site (mortgage.nationwidelicdensingsystem.org) provides the MU4R questions and registration required for employment in this position.

Basic Qualifications

  • Participate in the review and evaluation of product design changes and changes affecting processing / material testing requirements.

title: Refrigeration Assembler
description:
Job Title: Refrigeration Assembler

Reports To: Department Lead

Job Purpose

This position assembles the refrigeration system of the chamber through following blueprints/mechanical engineering drawings. This position starts with a structural steel frame and mounts components and does the line piping.

Duties and Responsibilities

Entry Level I

  • Cuts copper
  • Applies Armaflex to refrigeration lines
  • Applies RTV732 (Spaz)
  • Sweeps and cleans department
  • Straps refrigeration lines, bulb sensors, and insulates lines

Level II

  • Level I functions
  • Mounts tanks, drip pans, compressors, oil separators, and valves
  • Installs switches
  • Insulates machine pack
  • Installs gauges
  • Pipes drains for water
  • Reads parts lists
  • Using math functions accurately—multiplication, division, conversion of decimals to fractions

Level III

  • Level I and II functions
  • Reads, understands and interprets parts lists and mechanical engineering drawings
  • Sub-assembles refrigeration components
  • Performs soldering and brazing
  • Performs leak checks
  • Installs valve panels
  • Installs de-humid and evaporator coils

Level IV

  • Level I, II, III functions
  • Builds final assembly
  • Connects major sub-assemblies
  • Pressure checks at 200 PSI
  • Does water piping
  • Checks water piping at 60 PSI
  • Installs humidity systems-water socks, atomizing, demineralizing and recirculating water systems
  • Strategically mounts pipes and components, independently without guidance

Lead

  • Coordinates work of Level I, II, III, IV employees

Qualifications

  • Possession of High School Diploma or GED
  • History of good attendance
  • Task oriented
  • Preferred: previous experience working in a manufacturing environment
  • Preferred: experience and education in refrigeration, including wrapping, piping, soldering, brazing, and mounting of refrigeration components
  • Good math skills with ability to convert decimals to fractions
  • Demonstrated ability to follow procedures
  • Accuracy in reading a tape measure
  • Ability to read, understand parts list and fill out quality check sheets
  • Experience using power tools including drill and saws
  • Ability to obtain the necessary tools for this position: tape measure, screwdriver, wrenches, channel locks, copper cutters
  • A Current, Valid Driver’s License is Required

Working Conditions

Mostly standing work. Continuously lifting and carrying up to 20 pounds. Frequently lifting and carrying up to 50 lbs. Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 100 lbs. (Lifting more than 50 lbs overhead must be performed by using mechanical aids; if mechanical aids are not available, the lift will be performed by two employees in a team lift.) Detailed work with hands; fine work and simple grasping. Position may involve bending, squatting, climbing, reaching, and kneeling with occasional crawling and twisting. Periodic travel may be involved. As needed, will work at a desk and a computer screen for extended periods of time. Must be able to manually enter data to the computer system and understand the screen and images that appear.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Elixir)
description:
About Nabu Casa

Nabu Casa, Inc was founded in 2018 by the founders of both Home Assistant, the open source home automation platform, and Home Assistant OS, the operating system that turns your device into a smart home hub powered by Home Assistant. These projects have seen an immense growth and have helped shape DIY home automation communities around the world.

After being involved in the Internet of Things industry for many years, we realized that there is a need for a cloud service that aims to put users, their privacy and their data first. Such a cloud can only be built as an extension to a platform that does the same: Home Assistant.

With Nabu Casa we are building this cloud service and we’re calling it Home Assistant Cloud.

We are a profitable company with no external investors. Our funding comes directly from users who subscribe to Home Assistant Cloud and purchase Home Assistant hardware, ensuring our only stakeholders are our employees and our users. We also support other open-source projects, including those focused on hardware, standards, and voice technology.

The role

Nabu Casa is looking for a full-time Elixir Backend Engineer to join our Cloud & Infrastructure team and work primarily on Home Assistant Cloud services.

As one of the most active open-source projects in the world, Home Assistant exists because of its community. To empower this community and allow more users to enjoy the harder-to-reach features of Home Assistant, we have created our subscription service, Home Assistant Cloud. This service gives the community access to features usually reserved for power users with expensive hardware at home. Current features such as remote access and text-to-speech / speech-to-text support are made available without ever compromising on privacy.

What you are going to do

  • Build and maintain backend services primarily using Elixir.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, high-performance, and reliable backend applications.
  • Participate in code reviews as part of our collaborative development process.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Contribute to maintaining and improving the performance, quality, and responsiveness of the cloud services.
  • Implement security and data protection best practices in your work.
  • Help operate and support production services, including troubleshooting issues, improving reliability, and participating in the operational ownership of cloud systems.
  • Work on authentication, subscription, and payment-related services that power Home Assistant Cloud.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and share best practices with the team.

What you need to have

  • At least five years of professional experience in back-end development.
  • Professional experience developing production applications in Elixir.
  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Basic knowledge of system administration.
  • Experience with Git and GitHub.
  • Be based in North America, Latin America or Europe, and be able to regularly overlap with the team during the afternoon in Central European Time (CET). The team tries to schedule most meetings between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM CET to maximize collaboration across time zones.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience building or maintaining authentication and/or identity management systems.
  • Experience working with payment, billing, or subscription platforms.
  • Experience operating production systems, debugging live issues, and maintaining service reliability at scale.

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience with NestJS, Terraform, Grafana, or Python.
  • Personal experience using Home Assistant.
  • Knowledge of modern frontend application development.
  • Affinity with open-source development and philosophy.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and production incident response.

What we offer

Nabu Casa is a fully remote organization that uses Remote to employ people from all over the world. You will be a normal salaried employee in your country.

This is a full-time position for 40 hours per week. Because we are a fully remote company, there is no fixed schedule. The team tries to schedule most meetings between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM Central European Time (CET) to maximize collaboration across Europe and the Americas. While schedules are flexible, candidates should be comfortable occasionally adjusting their working hours to collaborate with teammates across time zones. You will report to our Cloud team's Engineering Manager, based in France.

Core to the establishment of Nabu Casa was the well-being of the people building the future of the smart home. We will provide all the benefits required by the country you reside in. However, we also want to make sure all our employees, regardless of country of origin, get at least a minimal set of benefits, including:

  • Five weeks, twenty-five days, of paid time off.
  • Fourteen days of paid sick leave if your country/laws treat them as unpaid.
  • Six weeks of paid and six weeks of unpaid parental leave to be used in the first year after birth. We will provide the missing days if your country/laws do not provide such compensation.
  • A budget for your work hardware once you start. After three years, you may keep this equipment for personal use.
  • An annual smart home budget to ensure you keep up to date with the latest smart home offerings.
  • A 50% contribution to your internet connection fee at your home workspace.
  • One day every two weeks to work on your personal projects.
  • If you are currently working on Home Assistant-related side projects, you can spend work time maintaining them.

When first offering a position to a new member, Nabu Casa aims to provide a total compensation package that matches the 75th percentile for the new hire's role, seniority, and local market rates. For this role in our primary operating countries, the approximate yearly compensation will be the following:

  • Canada: 105,000 – 129,100 CAD
  • United States: 120,000 – 155,000 USD
  • Latin America: 50,000 – 65,000 USD
  • Europe: Compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s location, experience, and local market rates.

These figures may be adjusted based on experience, qualifications, and work hours.

About us

Nabu Casa funds the development of Home Assistant and other projects at the Open Home Foundation. Nabu Casa is best known as the organization driving the development of Home Assistant, the world's largest free and open-source smart home platform. More than two million households benefit from its home automation capabilities. Powered by a worldwide community of open-source developers, GitHub ranked it the most active open-source project in the world in 2024.

We were initially founded to ensure that the development of Home Assistant would remain sustainable as it kept growing, but over time it has grown to support more open home initiatives. In 2024, the Open Home Foundation was formed to protect these open-source projects and ensure they thrive into the future. Nabu Casa is a commercial partner of the foundation, and our principles are aligned with a joint commitment to privacy, choice, and sustainability in the smart home. These are the values that we put at the heart of every decision we make. They are woven into our architecture, licensing, community, and everything else.

Nabu Casa is profitable, has no external investors, and our only funding comes from people subscribing to Home Assistant Cloud and buying Home Assistant hardware. That means the only stakeholders we have to concern ourselves with are our employees and our users.

Other Open Home Foundation projects and collaborations supported by Nabu Casa include:

  • Open hardware tools, such as ESPHome and ESP Web Tools.
  • Open standards, such as Python Matter Server, Z-Wave JS, ZigPy, BTHome, and Improv Wi-Fi.
  • Open voice, such as Rhasspy, Wyoming Protocol, and Piper.
  • Music Assistant.

The recruitment process

  • Our team will review your application with the hiring manager.
  • Screening.
  • Technical test.
  • Team interview.
  • Interview with our CTO and CEO.
  • Offer.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION:

Commercial Credit and Loan Administration, under the general supervision of the Senior Credit Risk Manager, evaluates the financial condition of businesses and individuals applying for commercial loans.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES:

Analyze commercial loan requests and make credit recommendations to the appropriate lending authority in accordance with the Bank's Loan Policy and Procedures Manual:

  • Work directly with Commercial Lending Officers to obtain all information necessary to underwrite loan requests.

  • Perform analyses of prospective Bank vendors on an annual basis, when appropriate, and upon request.
  • Prepare loan offering memoranda by analyzing financial, collateral, cash flow, and other relevant information regarding prospective borrowers and guarantors. Assess credit risk, determine creditworthiness, underwrite transactions in accordance with Loan Policy, and present recommendations to the appropriate lending authority.
  • Assist in collecting all pertinent financial and operating information on commercial borrowers to ensure ongoing financial capacity and compliance with loan covenants.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate financial records for each commercial borrower relationship.
  • Maintain commercial credit files to ensure the adequacy of loan documentation and supporting information.
  • Maintain a presence in local Chambers of Commerce and other civic or business organizations to promote community involvement and awareness of business lending opportunities.
  • On a limited basis, perform credit analysis of prospective Bank vendors.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
  • Complete all required compliance training in a timely manner.

  • Technical proficiency with Bank products and systems
  • Awareness of and interest in emerging technologies
