Banking education, training, or professional certifications are preferred. Strong financial analytical skills are required. Proficiency in Word, Excel, and other Microsoft Office applications is required. Familiarity with automated underwriting systems is a plus.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of executives, managers, and subject matter experts, are required.

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

0-2 years of commercial underwriting or related credit analysis experience. Knowledge of financial statement analysis, accounting principles, and relevant industry trends and practices is required.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Additional banking education and formal credit training are preferred.

title: OT Systems Technician
description:

About Hudbay:

Hudbay (TSX, NYSE: HBM) is a copper-focused mining company with three long-life operations and a world-class pipeline of copper growth projects in tier-one mining-friendly jurisdictions of Canada, Peru, and the United States.


Hudbay’s operating portfolio includes the Constancia mine in Cusco (Peru), the Snow Lake operations in Manitoba (Canada) and the Copper Mountain mine in British Columbia (Canada). Copper is the primary metal produced by the company, which is complemented by meaningful gold production. Hudbay’s growth pipeline includes the Copper World project in Arizona, the Mason project in Nevada (United States), the Llaguen project in La Libertad (Peru) and several expansion and exploration opportunities near its existing operations.


The value Hudbay creates and the impact it has is embodied in its purpose statement: “We care about our people, our communities, and our planet. Hudbay provides the metals the world needs. We work sustainably, transform lives, and create better futures for communities.” Hudbay’s mission is to create sustainable value and strong returns by leveraging its core strengths in community relations, focused exploration, mine development and efficient operations.


Mission:

To create sustainable value and strong returns by leveraging our core strengths in community relations, focused exploration, mine development and efficient operations.


Purpose of Role:

Reporting directly to the Mine Technology Networks & Infrastructure Supervisor, the OT Systems Technician focuses on maintaining critical system connectivity and adhering to established safety standards. The OT Systems Technician supports the industrial network and wireless infrastructure to ensure autonomous machinery and heavy equipment remain connected and operational across active mining pits and remote field locations.

  • Fleet Integration: Install and troubleshoot onboard hardware including GNSS (GPS) antennas, ruggedized routers (Cisco IE), and data loggers on heavy earthmoving equipment (Trucks, Dozers, Drills).

  • Networking: Proficiency in IP addressing, VLANs, and troubleshooting Layer 2/3 connectivity.
  • FMS Knowledge: Experience with Fleet Management Systems (e.g., Cat MineStar,).

title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
description:
Position Purpose:

The Continuous Improvement Specialist is a hands-on, site-based individual contributor responsible for facilitating kaizen events, leading structured problem-solving initiatives, tracking and managing continuous improvement projects, and implementing process improvements directly on the production floor. This role will work across plastic injection molding, assembly, and paint operations to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost within an AS9100-certified aerospace manufacturing environment. The Continuous Improvement Specialist will be highly visible and accessible on the shop floor, collaborating with cross-functional teams including operations, quality, and engineering to translate Lean and Six Sigma concepts into practical, sustainable, operator-level execution.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Facilitate Continuous Improvement Activities: Lead and facilitate kaizen events, improvement workshops, and Gemba walks to eliminate waste, reduce process variation, and improve flow across molding, assembly, and paint operations.

Lead Structured Problem Solving: Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving activities using A3 methodology, 5-Why analysis, root cause corrective action (RCCA), and fishbone diagrams to address quality issues, process inefficiencies, and customer concerns.

Implement Improvements On-Site: Implement improvements hands-on at the site, working directly with operators, supervisors, and team leads to ensure changes are practical, operator-friendly, and embedded into daily work.

Track and Manage CI Projects: Track and manage multiple continuous improvement projects simultaneously using CI project tracking or management system, ensuring alignment with site strategic objectives and timelines.

Analyze Process and Quality Data: Analyze production, quality, and process data (e.g., nonconformities, scrap, rework, cycle times, equipment downtime, audit findings) to identify trends, root causes, and priority improvement opportunities.

Develop and Monitor KPIs: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for process performance and operational effectiveness, including First Pass Yield (FPY), on-time delivery (OTD), defects per unit, scrap rates, and CAPA cycle time.

Conduct Value Stream Mapping: Conduct Value Stream Mapping exercises to identify waste, bottlenecks, and non-value-added activities across molding, assembly, and paint processes.

Develop Standard Work: Develop and implement standard work, visual management systems (6S), and process controls to reduce variation and improve consistency.

Support AS9100 Quality Management System: Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to ensure improvement actions support AS9100 Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and are embedded in processes for long-term sustainability.

Participate in Corrective Action Processes: Support corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, participating in root cause investigations and ensuring effectiveness of corrective actions.

Standardize Best Practices: Standardize and document best practices, lessons learned, and improved methods, supporting deployment across departments and ensuring compliance with aerospace quality and regulatory requirements.

Provide Training and Coaching: Provide training and coaching to employees and leaders on Lean Six Sigma tools, continuous improvement methodologies, and problem-solving techniques.

Support New Product Introduction (NPI): Facilitate continuous improvement activities for new product introduction (NPI) programs, ensuring processes are optimized from launch.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work collaboratively with operations, quality, engineering, and supply chain teams to drive improvements, break down silos, and enable teamwork.

· Problem Solving. Uses rigorous logic and methods to solve difficult problems with effective solutions; probes all fruitful sources for answers; can see hidden problems; is excellent at honest analysis; looks beyond the obvious and does not stop at the first answers.

· Drive for Results. Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.

· Interpersonal Savvy. Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people0.

· Influencing Without Authority. Builds consensus and drives change through collaboration; can effectively influence and coach employees at all levels without direct supervisory authority.

· Continuous Improvement Mindset. Demonstrates passion for continuous improvement and dissatisfaction with the status quo; motivated to pursue positive change; exhibits curiosity and a learning orientation.

· Attention to Detail. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.

· Customer Service Orientation. Focuses on meeting the needs of internal customers (operations teams) and external aerospace customers.

· Hands-On Approach. Action-oriented and comfortable working directly on the shop floor in manufacturing environments; spend significant time on the production floor observing, engaging, and identifying improvement opportunities.

· Adaptability. Able to work in high-paced and changing manufacturing environments; flexible and resilient in the face of obstacles.

· Analytical Thinking. Skilled at synthesis and analysis; able to translate complex data into actionable insights.

· Responsible to follow and ensure compliance with all established Vaupell policies, standard operating procedures, and safety practices.

· Other duties as assigned.


Job Qualifications/Requirements

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, Lean manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, or quality improvement roles, preferably in aerospace or other regulated manufacturing environments.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and manufacturing experience.

Continuous Improvement Expertise: Hands-on experience facilitating kaizen events, leading improvement workshops, and driving cross-functional process improvements using Lean methodologies.

Problem-Solving: Proven experience with A3 problem solving, root cause analysis (5-Why, fishbone/Ishikawa), and corrective action methodologies.

Six Sigma Green Belt (Minimum): Six Sigma Green Belt certification (minimum) with practical application of DMAIC and data-driven decision making.

Lean Tools & Methods: Experience with Value Stream Mapping, standard work, visual management, 6S, Gemba walks, and waste identification.

Quality System Knowledge: Working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 requirements, particularly corrective action, continual improvement, and process standardization.

Manufacturing Knowledge:: Understanding of manufacturing processes; experience with plastics injection molding, assembly, and paint/coating operations preferred.

Communication Skills: Strong communication, facilitation, and training skills with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization.

Candidates must be a "US Person" (i.e., US Citizen or Permanent Resident) to ensure Vaupell's compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) and EAR (Export Administration Regulations).

Environmental Condition

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and vibrations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to occasionally loud. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

This position requires a combination of office and manufacturing floor environment work. The employee will spend significant time standing and walking on the production floor (40–60% of the workday) with regular sitting for documentation, analysis, and reporting (30–40%). Frequent use of hands and fingers is required for grasping, handling, keyboarding, and coordination, along with routine sensory demands including hearing and near/far vision, depth, and color perception. Occasional bending, reaching, turning/twisting, stair climbing, and lifting/carrying/pushing up to and over 50 lbs. may be required (20% or less).

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, belief and spirituality, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ethnicity/national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran, or disability status.

title: SACC- Jackson
description:
About Company:

The YMCA, or Young Men's Christian Association, is a community-focused organization that aims to promote healthy living, youth development, and social responsibility. YMCA programs often include fitness classes, youth sports, after-school care, summer camps, and community service initiatives. The organization emphasizes values such as caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility, working to build a sense of community and support for personal growth. Today, the YMCA continues to adapt to the needs of its local communities, addressing issues like health, education, and social equity.

About the Role:

We are seeking a School Aged Childcare Staff to join our team at Clay County YMCA in CLAY. As a School Aged Childcare Staff, you will be responsible for providing a safe and nurturing environment for children in our care. You will be responsible for planning and implementing age-appropriate activities that promote physical, social, and intellectual growth. You will also be responsible for maintaining accurate records of attendance, medication administration, and incident reports. Your role will be critical in ensuring that our program meets the highest standards of quality and safety.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience working with school-aged children
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPR / First Aid certified

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and implement age-appropriate activities that promote physical, social, and intellectual growth
  • Ensure the safety and well-being of all children in our care
  • Maintain accurate records of attendance, medication administration, and incident reports
  • Communicate effectively with parents and guardians regarding their child's progress and needs
  • Collaborate with other staff members to ensure that our program meets the highest standards of quality and safety

Skills:

As a School Aged Childcare Staff, you will need to have excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with children, parents, and other staff members. You will also need to have strong organizational and time-management skills to plan and implement activities and maintain accurate records. Additionally, you will need to have a strong understanding of child development and be able to create a safe and nurturing environment that promotes growth and learning. Finally, you will need to be able to work collaboratively with other staff members to ensure that our program meets the highest standards of quality and safety.
